tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs kyi rnam par bshad pa mkha' spyod lam bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs kyi rnam par bshad pa mkha' spyod lam bzang zhes bya ba/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /yan lag bdun ldan sku ni pad ma rā ga'i mdog mtshungs mtshan nyid rdzogs/ /drug cu'i dbyangs ldan gsung ni so so'i skad du dam chos legs par ston/ /ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa'i thugs ni rnam par rtog med lhun gyis grub/ /rgyal ba'i yum mchog rnal 'byor ma dpal dag dang dbyer med bla mar 'dud/ /lnga rigs paṇa chen kun gyi gtsug gi rgyan/ /drug gnyis dka' spyad mthar phyin brtson pa'i phul/ /bdun ldan sku mnyes dbang mos rjes su bzung / /brgyad ldan dbang phyug nā ro ta par 'dud/ /gang gsung zhal gyi bdud rtsi mtho ris chab/ /lo paṇa las 'bab gang thugs rgya mtshor sim/ /'phrin las chu klung phyogs brgyar legs babs pa'i/ /sa skya'i 'jam mgon brgyud par bcas rnams rgyal/ /khyad par rgyal bas lung bstan e waṃ pa/ /nges don bstan pa rgyas mdzad mus pa rje/ /snyan brgyud rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag tshar chen sogs/ /lugs 'dir bka' drin che rnams 'dir phyag yin/ /de ltar dam pa'i phyag srol las byung ba'i/ /skal bzang mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i lam bzang 'di/ /ci nus dbye yi don gnyer grogs mchog sogs/ /bdag dang skal mnyam tshogs rnams gar byos shig /ces mchod par brjod cing bshad par dam bca' ba dang spro ba skyed pa'i tshig sngon du btang nas/ 'dir rje btsun nā ro pa chen pos mdzad pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs bshad pa la don gnyis te/ chos spyi'i rnam gzhag bstan pas blo gros yangs par byas/

skabs don rgyas par bshad pas/ nyams rtogs rgyas par bya ba'o/ /dang po ni/ 'o skol rnams kyi ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi phung po ji snyed cig gsungs pa'i brjod bya bsdu na theg pa che chung gnyis las/ 'dir theg pa chen po'i nyams len ston te/ nyan thos theg pa 'di la ni/ /spyod pa yongs bsngo ma bshad pas/ /theg pa chen por ga la rung / /zhes gsungs/ theg chen la yang rgyu 'bras gnyis las khyad par du 'phags pa gsang sngags te/ mdo sde gdams ngag 'bogs pa'i rgyal po las/ 'dren pa'i theg pa gsum po dag /bcom ldan nges par gsungs lags na/ /rgyu 'bras lhun grub tu spyod cing / /sangs rgyas gzhan nas mi 'tshol ba'i/ /nges pa'i theg pa cis ma gsungs/ /zhes ba'i lan du/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' bstsal pa/ /rgyu la mos pa rgyu chos kyi/ /'khor lo rab tu bskor byas nas/ /rdo rje theg pa'i nye lam zhig /ma 'ongs dus na 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas shes so/ /sngags kyi theg pa'i 'dod tshul la mang du yod na'ang / 'di rje btsun rtse mos gur gyi dgongs pa la/ dgos pa mang po la dgongs nas rgyud sde bzhir bzhed do/ /mdor na spyi'i rnam gzhag rgyas par shes par 'dod na rje btsun rtse mos mdzad pa'i rgyud sde spyi rnam chen mo mkhas pa'i bshad srol gyi gsal byed dang bcas pa rnams las shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa skabs don rgyas par bshad la gnyis te/ bde mchog gsang mtha'i lam rim spyir bstan/ de nyid kyi snying po phyung ba'i nyams len bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni 'khor lo bde mchog gi dgongs pa dang / de'i 'grel byed rnams rgyud sde drug tu bzhed de/ rtsa rgyud le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa las/ ji srid mdo bya spyod pa ni/ /rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i dbye ba yis/ /sems can mos pas 'jug pa rnams/ /de dang de la dga' ba yi/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don la/

mdo zhes pa 'chad tshul gnyis las/ gtso bo mdo sde rtog pa'i rgyud la 'chad/ de bzhin du bya ba dang / spyod pa dang / rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang / gsang zhes pa gsang ba 'dus pa la sogs pa pha rgyud sde gsum/ mtha'i zhes pa/ dges pa rdo rje dus kyi 'khor lo la sogs pa ma rgyud sgo drug dbye ba yis zhes pa de'i nang tshan gyi bye brag drug pa dpal bde mchog gi rgyud do/ /'dir rtsa rgyud rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum las rtsa rgyud rgyas pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa le'u 'bum pa ston pa rdo rje 'chang chen pos gsungs/ de dus kyi dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi don byas te sgra nam mkha' la dengs te/ a bhi dha na las/ kye kye dpa' bo chen po ste/ /khyod kyi ye shes gang mthong ba/ /ye shes shes bya chen po ste/ /de ni de'i ngang du thim/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /yang dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis/ tshogs mchod sngon du btang nas/ 'bring po gsung par gsol ba btab pas rtsa rgyud 'bring po sh+lo ka 'bum pa gsungs/ de dus kyi gdul bya rnams kyi don byas nas/ bai ḍūr+ya'i shog bu la gser zhun mas glegs bam du bris nas/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis rgyas btab ste nub phyogs o ṭi bhi sha'i gtsug lag khang du bzhugs so/ /yang gdul bya mi rnams kyi don du 'gyur ba'i rtsa rgyud gsung bar zhus pas bsdus pa yi ge 'bum pa le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa 'di gsungs so/ /'di don 'grel byed so so'i bkral tshul bzhi yod pa las/ rtsa rgyud kyi dgongs pa bshad rgyud rnam pa lnga'i gsang mthar 'chad de/ bshad rgyud lnga ni/ slob dpon ka rgyal zla bas/ 'byung dang mkha' 'gro kun sbyong dang / /kha sbyor rgyud dang bla ma ste/ /bshad rgyud rnam pa lngar 'dod do/ /zhes pa lnga ni/ he ru ka mngon 'byung / rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ rnal 'byor ma kun spyod/ dpal sam+bu ṭa/ a bhi dha na rnams kyis bkral ba'i gsang mtha' 'di/

bde mchog gzhan las zab ste/ spyir theg dman nas rdo rje theg pa'i bar dman sems spongs shing rtogs rig yar ldan du 'gro ba las 'og ma 'og ma las/ gong ma gong ma zab tshul spyi bshad ltar yin pa las/ gsang mtha' mchog tu zab ste rtsa rgyud las/ pho nya rnam gsum legs bsres nas/ /sgrub ba po yi dngos grub thob/ /ces gsungs/ gsang mtha'i lam rim ni/ sbyin bya bzhi/ bslab bya gnyis/ grogs spyod pa gnyis kyis mtshams sbyar nas/ 'bras bu mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub sgrub par byed do/ /dang po ni/ lo nag gnyis kyi phyi'i dkyil 'khor du/ smin byed kyi dbang bskur ba ma thob pa la gang zag mchog ma yin pa rnams kyi dril bu lus dkyil dang / rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lam nyams su blangs na/ rtsa ltung 'byung bar gsungs te/ yongs su ma smin sems can la/ /gsang ba sgrogs pa bdun pa yin/ /zhes gsungs/ rnal 'byor ma'i bskyed rdzogs kyi lam nyams su len pa la yang / sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor du byin rlabs dbang bzhi'i tshul du thob dgos te/ sbyor ba nges par ma byas par/ /skal min gsang ba ston pa dang / /zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi yan lag gi ltung ba 'byung ba'i phyir/ bslab bya gnyis la slob tshul yang blo dman nas rim gyis 'khrid pa'i dbang du byas te/ dang por phyi rtogs brtags sems la gnad du bsnun pa gtso bor byas te/ nang lus la zhar byung gi tshul gyis bsnun pa/ nag po chos skor gyis 'khrid/ de nas phyi nang gnyis ka la cha mnyam du bsnun pa grub chen lū hi pa'i 'khrid/ de nas phyi spros pa spangs te/ zab mo lus la gnad du bsnun pa/ dril bu'i chos skor gyi 'khrid do/ /'di dag gi rnam dbye rgyas par bde mchog chos 'byung sogs su gzigs/ gnyis pa de nyid kyi snying po phyung ba'i nyams len rgyas par bshad pa ni/ de ltar lo nag dril gsum gyi nyams len de dag bogs dbyung zhing 'bras bu 'byin pa dang /

tshe gcig gis sangs rgyas sgrub par byed pa/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i chos skor 'di ni/ rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i rtsa bshad kyi rgyud thams cad kyi snying po phyung ba'i man ngag rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nyid kyis nā ro ta pa la dngos su gnang ba'i nā ro mkha' spyod kyi gdams ngag 'di yin la/ nā ro pa de nyid la slob ma'i mchog 'phags yul na yongs su grags pa'i paṇa chen bcu gnyis tsam dang / bod yul nas dka' ba du ma spyad nas byon pa'i thugs sras mar pa lo tsā ba rnams yod kyang de dag la ma gnang bar/ bal po pham mthing pa sku mched la slob bshad kyis tshul du gnang ba'i zab chos klog skya shes rab brtsegs pa dang / mal lo tsā ba la rim gyis brgyud de sa skya pa chen po la bka' babs pa'i gdams pa khyad par can yin la/ sa chen la yang spyir bla med dang 'brel ba'i gdams pa rgya mtsho lta bu yod pa las/ mchog tu gyur pa gser chos bcu gsum gyi nang tshan mchog bsgrubs pas thun mong zhar las 'byung ba dmar mo skor gsum du grags pa in+d+ra mkha' spyod/ mai tri mkha' spyod/ nā ro mkha' spyod gsum las/ de'i nang nas mchog tu gyur pa nā ro mkha' spyod kyi gdams pa yin la/ 'di 'chad pa la don gsum ste/ gang gi nyams su len pa'i gang zag de'i nyams su blang ba'i lam/ nyams su blangs pa'i 'bras bu dang gsum/ dang po la smin lam mjug rung gi gang zag grol lam sgom rung gi gang zag dang gnyis/ dang po ni/ spyir rdo rje theg pa nas bshad pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad tshang na rab/ mdor bsdus pa ni rdo rje snying 'grel las/ brtan zhing dul la blo gros ldan/ /bzod ldan drang la g.yo sgyu med/ /ces bshad pa ltar gyi mtshan nyid tshang zhing 'khor lo bde mchog lo nag dril gsum gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi thob pa rab/ gsum char gyi dbang ma thob kyang lo nag gang rung gi rdul tshon ras bris su thob pa ni 'bring /

de'i dbang ye ma thob kyang ma rgyud kye rdor lta bu'i dbang thob pa tha ma'o/ /gnyis pa grol lam sgom rung gi gang zag ni/ sngar gyi de'i steng du/ sam+bu ṭa las/ bskal pa kun gyi sngon grub pa'i/ /slob dpon chen po gdod nas gnas/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sgrub pa po rang nyid kyi sems nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor mar ye gdod ma nas gnas pa de ngo sprod pa'i ched du sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs legs par thob cing rgyun du 'chag med du nyams su len pa byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems brtan po dang ldan zhing / so thar nas rdo rje theg pa'i bar gyi thun mong dang / 'khor lo bde mchog gi thun mong ma yin pa'i dam tshig rnams ma nyams shing nyams su blang bya'i lam la sgro 'dogs chod cing / de'i steng du yang 'di'i sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du thob pa'i dam tshig la gnas nas nyams su blang bya'i rnal 'byor bcu gcig sogs la sgro 'dogs chod cing sems can gyi don du myur du phyag rgya chen po sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par 'dod pa'i blo can te/ slob dpon rdo rje dril bus pas/ 'gro don don la rab gzhol ba/ /rang rgyud sngags dang rnal 'byor shes/ /zhes so/ /de lta bu'i gang zag rab kyis sgom bzlas la brten nas mchog gi dngos grub 'grub/ 'bring gi sin+dhu ra'i sgrub pa la brten nas 'grub/ tha mas 'pho ba'i gdams ngag la brten nas bar dor 'grub/ shin tu tha ma ni skye ba phyi ma rnams su rnal 'byor ma'i bzlas sgom byed pa'i rigs su skyes te nam zhig nas mkha' spyod du bgrod pa'o/ /gang zag des bsam gtan bsgom pa la/ gang du bsgom pa'i gnas/ der gdan gang gi steng du/ spyod lam dang bsam gtan ji lta bus/ nam bsgom pa'i dus/ kha gang la bltas nas/ tshul ji ltar du bsgom pa rnams las/

gnas ni/ nges brjod dam/ mngon brjod dam/ a bhi da na ste/ mtshan gyi rnam grangs gsum dang ldan pa las/ ri sul dang ni ri rtse dang / /chu bo'i ngogs dang 'dus pa dang / /rgya mtsho chen po'i 'gram dag dang / /shing gcig dang ni zhi ba'i gnas/ /ma mo'i khyim dang dur khrod dang / /sna tshogs skyed mos tshal mchog gam/ /lha khang dang ni mchod rten nam/ /khyim mam bzhi mdo dag tu ni/ /sgrub pa po yis sbyar bsgrub na/ /'dod pa kun gyi 'bras bu gsal/ /gnas ni brtag par byas pa'am/ /yid ni gang du dga' ba der/ /sna tshogs bde mchog dam pa der/ /de ru bsgrubs na dngos grub 'gyur/ /dbye ba du mas bsgom pa ni/ /gdul bya'i bsam pa'i dbang gis so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i ri sul nas bzhi mdo'i bar rnams gdul bya'i bsam pa'i dbang gis rgyas par dbye ba yin la/ mdor bsdu na yid ni gang du dga' ba der zhes pa ste/ kye rdo rjer/ dang po goms par byed dus kyi/ /gnas ni gang du bsngags pa'i sems/ /gcig tu mnyam bzhag 'grub gyur pa'i/ /gnas ni bzang po nges par brtag /rang gi khyim du zhes gsungs pa dang mthun pas/ las dang po ba 'tshe ba med cing bkra shis pa'i gnas su bsgom pa khyad par can du bsngags pa'am yang na dur khrod du bsgom kyang rung ste/ bar chad 'ong gi dogs nas/ bsgom pa la brtson 'grus rtsom pa'i dgos pa yod pas so/ /der gdan gang gi steng du 'dug pa ni/ bsgom pa'i dus su rnal 'byor pa'i gdan la he ru ka'i chas drug nas gsungs pa ro gdan dngos sam/ ras la sogs pa la ro'i gzugs brnyan bris pa'am/ ro gdan bting bar bsam pa'am/ yang na ro ras zhes pa ro dur khrod du bskyal ba'i gos blangs pa bting ba'i dgos pa ni ro la bdag med pa bzhin du/ rnal 'byor pas kyang bdag med rtogs pa dang / bdag med la 'dris goms byed pa'i dgos pa yod do/ /bsnyen pa'i dus su g.yam pa sogs la sna tshogs rdo rje bris pa'ang gdan 'og tu 'jug ste/

slob dpon gnyis med rdo rje'i bsgrub thabs las/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i mtshan ma'i bde ba'i stan la zhes dang / kam pa las/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i gdan la gnas pas/ /zhes so spyi dang bye brag gi dkon mchog gi rten yod na bsham/ med kyang 'gal ba med la ji ltar dgos pa'i mchod gtor rdor dril la sogs pa nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad rnams ma tshang ba med pa tshul bzhin bsham mo/ /spyod lam dang bsam gtan ji lta bus 'dug na/ rdo rje gur las/ rdo rje dkyil krung rnam bcas nas zhes gsungs pa ltar rkang pa rdo rje'i dkyil krung ngam/ de ma nus na'ang sems dpa'i dkyil krung sogs lus bsam gtan gyi spyod lam nges par bca' zhing / nyal ba dang 'phres pa sogs nges par mi rung ste/ grub chen nā ro pa nyid kyis/ mi mos nyal sngags bzla ba spang / /zhes gsungs so/ /bsam gtan yang 'di bzhin bya dgos te/ sgrub thabs kyi thog mar dal 'byor rnyed par dka' ba bsam pa dang / skyes bu dam ba dang mjal bar dka' ba bsam pa dang / dam pa'i chos zab mo dang 'phrad par dka' ba bsam pa sogs bya ste sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis/ dal 'byor 'di ni shin tu g.yo ba dang / /'jig rten skye bo dam pa 'phrad rnyed dka'/ /de bas shes rab thabs la gzhol ba yi/ /yid la byed pa mchog 'di bsgrub par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar nges 'byung dang byang sems sogs sngon 'gro'i chos zhib tu bsams nas blo khul nges bya ba brtag dpyad legs por byas nas 'jug dgos kyi gya tshom du mi 'jug gsung ngo / /nam bsgoms pa'i dus ni/ kye rdo rjer/ rang gi khyim du mtshan dus su/ /bdag nyid 'grub pa'i sems kyis ni/ /rnal 'byor ma bsgom shes rab can/ /zhes pa ltar las dang po pa rnam rtog nyung bas mtshan mo'i dus la lhag par 'bad cing thun gsum thun bzhi la sogs pa mnyam rjes kun tu gzhan don bsam pas bsgom mo/ /kha gang la bltas nas tshul ji ltar du bsgom na sngags kyi rgyud sde phal cher las shar du blta bar bshad pa ni/

shar phyogs su dbang po gnas pa dang / nyi zla 'ong bas bkra shis pa'i phyogs yin pa la dgongs so/ /bya spyod phal cher dang / dur khrod las shar dang byang thabs kyi phyogs dang / nub dang lho gnyis shes rab kyi phyogs yin pas shes rab kyi phyogs su blta bar bshad pa bzhin/ 'dir yang shes rab kyi phyogs lhor kha blta ba'i mos pa bya ste rgyu mtshan shes rab kyi rgyud gtso bor byas pas skor phyogs la ltos nas g.yas skor thabs/ g.yon skor shes rab las/ 'dir g.yon skor/ lag pa yang g.yas thabs g.yon shes rab la/ 'dir bya ba thams cad g.yon pas byed pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ 'jig rten na rtag g.yon nas spyod/ /rkang pa g.yon pa sngon la 'dor/ /lag pa g.yon pa sngon du 'gyur/ /g.yon gyi spyod pas rab mchod byed/ /lus kyi g.yon ni rnam par 'khri/ /g.yon pa yis ni tshim par bza'/ /brtul zhugs ma nyams brtul zhugs rdzogs/ /sgrub po de ni dam tshig brtson/ /zhes dang / rkang pa yang g.yas thabs g.yon shes rab la/ 'dir g.yon pa sngon la 'dor/ rje btsun gyis nag po bshad sbyar las/ de la g.yon nas bskor ba zhes bya ba ni/ phyogs thams cad shar nas g.yon bskor yin te/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang / chos thams cad shes rab g.yon pa las byung ba ste 'gro kun g.yon las byung ba yin/ zhes bya ba yin no/ /pu hrangs lo chung lugs kyi nag 'bum du/ g.yon pa'i kun tu spyod pa ni/ nang bar mal nas langs pa'i dus su rkang pa g.yon pa sngon du 'dor ba dang / lag pa g.yon pas zas bza' ba dang mchod pa la sogs pa bya'o/ /g.yon pas byed pa'i dgos pa ni/ g.yon ngos na rtsa rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma yod pas/ de la brten nas bde ba skyed/ de la brten nas sems zin pas mi rtog pa dang / stong pa nyid rgyud la skye bas stong ba nyid la gus pa bskyed pa'i ched du'o/ /zhes gsungs/ phyogs la shar dang byang thabs/ lho dang nub shes rab las 'dir lhor blta/

'o na lho dang nub gnyis ka shes rab kyi phyogs yin pa la nub tu mi blta zhing lhor blta ba'i rgyu mtshan gang zhe na/ 'dir lhor blta ba la dgos pa khyad bar can yod de/ spyir gdul bya gang na yod pa der 'dul byed gzigs dgos pa la bde mchog gi gdul bya ni drag po dbang phyug 'khor bcas yin pa lhor yod pa dang / gling gsum skyes pa'i mi rnams ni longs spyod che zhing dbang po brtul la chos kyi snod ma yin par dgongs nas mi gzigs shing / lho 'dzam bu gling pa rnams longs spyod chung zhing dbang po rno la chos kyi snod du gyur par dgongs pa dang / dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyang 'dzam bu gling pa'i mi'i lus re re la brten nas mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar bzhed pas dag pa'i zhing yin pa sogs la dgongs pa'o/ /mos pa ni 'jig rten pa'i lho phyogs su mos pa yin gyi rnal 'byor pas ni/ kha gang bstan shar yin pa'o/ /yang bha wa bha dras zhal lhor bstan pa ni shes rab kyi phyogs dang dga' ba'i yul yin pas so/ /zhes gsungs/ la wa bas/ zhal lhor bstan pa shes rab kyi phyogs bshad pa'i don ni gong dang 'dra la/ dga' ba ni phyogs la ltos nas 'jig rten pa'i shar phyogs dag dang / byang khyad dga' las 'jig rten pa'i lhor rnal 'byor pa'i shar skye dka' ba dga' ba bzhi'i nang gi dga' ba dang / 'jig rten pa'i nub rnal 'byor pa'i byang lhan skyes yin pas khyad par 'phags/ de la dga' ba'i phyogs lho yin pas skye dga' ba la/ bltas pas lan cig don 'grub gsung ngo / /tshul ji ltar du bsgom na/ kyai rdo rjer/ chu bo'i rgyud ni rab 'bab dang / /mar me'i rtse mo rab bcings ltar/ /rtag tu zhes pa ltar/ sems rnam rtog gzhan gyis bar ma chod cing / drag cing gsal ba'i tshul gyi bsgom zhing / 'grub bam mi 'grub bam snyam pa'i dogs pa sogs spangs te sems rtse gcig pa dgos te/

de nyid las/ dogs pa med pa'i sems kyis ni/ /'di yi las rnams thams cad byed/ /ces pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa de ltar gang zag dbang po rab 'bring bzhi char gyis nyams su len rgyu'i chos la don gsum ste/ thog mar bshad bya'i gsung rab sogs rnam gzhag spyir bstan pa/ gzhung dang sbyar nas bskyed rim 'khor bcas bshad pa/ shin tu zab pa'i rdzogs pa'i rim pa bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ bskyed pa'i rim pa phag mo mkha' spyod/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa rtsa dbu ma/ lam gyi yan lag gnod sbyin mo dbang du bya ba/ pra sen dbab pa/ sman chen po'i bcud len la sogs pa rnams te/ rtsa rgyud le'u so gcig gnyis kyang snang / pa las/ rdo rje phag mo de yi ni/ /sku mdog mtshon cha 'phyar la gzigs/ /zhes pas lha bstan/ le'u zhe bdun pa las/ de la mkha' 'gro ma'i rigs pa chen po bzlas na rigs thams cad dbang du byed par 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu bzlas brjod byas na dpal chen po bskyed par 'gyur ro/ /zhes phag mo'i nye snying la brten pa'i las tshogs gsungs/ le'u zhe brgyad pa las/ de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ste/ /mkha' 'gro kun gyi bde ba'i mchog /snying po'i rnal 'byor ma kun gyi/ /'dod pa'i las kun sgrub pa po/ /gang zhig dran pa tsam gyis ni/ /'jig rten gsum po g.yo byed cing / /rjes su dran pa tsam gyis kyang / /yang dag dngos grub rim gyis ster/ /oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭaḥswā hā/ sngags 'di bzlas pas 'grub pa ste/ /las rnams kun byed dge ba yin/ /mkha' 'gro rnal 'byor ma rnams dang / /khaṇ+ḍa ro ha lā ma sogs/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni thams cad kyi/ /sngags ni 'di nyid yin par bshad/ /sa 'og yang na mtho ris sam/ /de bzhin mi yul dag tu yang / /las ni gang dag yod pa rnams/ /bklags pas de dag thams cad 'grub/ /'di las shin tu mchog gyur gang / /'jig rten gsum na ci yang med/

/gang phyir 'di ni bla med pa/ /las rnams thams cad sgrub byed yin/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni kun gyi gnas/ /mdo bshad rgyas pa ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs/ gzhung de rnams kyi dbang du mdzad nas/ jo bo nā ro ta pas bskyed rdzogs kyi gzhung chung 'di mdzad/ gzhung dngos bstan las rnal 'byor brgyad las ma bstan yang nyal ldang khrus gsum man ngag gis kha bskangs nas/ rje sa chen gyi bskyed rim gyi gzhung brgyad rdzogs rim gyi gzhung bzhi ste bcu gnyis mdzad de/ de rnams kyang sgrub thabs spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor las 'phros pa'i phyi mchod mdor bsdus de'i zhar la rjes gnang ngam byin rlabs gcig yod phyag len mi mdzad par gda'/ bskyed rim dang bzlas sgom la brten nas mkha' spyod sgrub pa/ byin rlabs kyi yi ge tshogs mchod/ tshes bcu'i mchod pa/ sbyin sreg mar me'i sbyin sreg pra sen dbab pa/ rgyud kyi dum bu gnod sbyin mo'i sgrub thabs tshangs pa'i bu mo bsgrub pa/ pad+ma pa ti'i man ngag khol bo pa ti'i man ngag sman chen po'i bcud len te/ dum bu 'di dag 'bri ba la/ go rim nges pa mi snang ngo gsungs/ la la sa chen gyis ma mdzad kyang don 'khrul med yin no/ /rje btsun chen pos mdzad pa'i rtsa dbu ma 'di gzhung dngos bstan yab la sbyar yang / bla ma phyi ma rnams kyis yum la'ang sbyar bar mdzad de/ rdo rje 'chang gi nye brgyud kyi brgyud 'debs las/ bskyed rim zab mo'i mkha' spyod rnal 'byor dang / /rdzogs rim dbu ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i mthus/ /bde chen lhan skyes ye shes skye ba dang / /mkha' spyod go 'phang thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes gsungs pas/ sbyar lugs ni yab yum tha dad du mkhyen dgos/ spyir rtsa dbu ma la phyag len gces bsdus na bzhugs pa/ man ngag gces bsdus na bzhugs pa sogs yod pas mtha' gcig tu ma nges so/ /gang ltar rje sa chen gyi phag mo las bcu'i gzhung mdzad/

las bcu ni rang gzhan gyi don byed pa la las kyi yan lag bcu dgos te/ thog mar bsnyen pa gzhan don du slob ma rjes bzung / tshes bcu dang 'brel ba'i tshogs mchod/ rang gzhan gnyis ka dang 'brel ba gzhon nu ma'i mchod pa/ gnas skabs thams cad dang 'brel ba gtor ma/ dman pa'i dngos grub dang 'brel ba sbyin sreg bu chung gsar bu la phan 'dogs pa srung 'khor/ las rtsub mo'i dbang du byas te gdug pa can tshar gcod pa sum+bha ni'i cho ga bsgom pas phyir bzlog pa dang / bris pas phyir bzlog pa dang bcu yin no/ /'di dag ni rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi ma tshang ba kha skong ba yin kyang gtso bor zhal gnyis ma'i skor/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi las bcu'i gsal byed sogs dang / zhal gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs su/ nyal ldang khrus gsum gsungs nas/ phag mo gang du 'di gsum ma tshang ba 'dis kha bskang bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'phags pa rin po ches/ mngon rtogs/ dkyil chog tshogs 'khor/ sbyin sreg rnams/ bla ma dam pa'i dngos slob sngags 'chang gzungs pas/ man ngag rin po che'i gter zhes bya ba sgrub thabs rdzogs rim cung zad/ mdun skyed mchod chog slob ma la byin rlabs bya tshul/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg der gzhir bzhag nas rgyas pa dang dbang drag rnams bya tshul/ mar me'i sbyin sreg yi ge brgya pa la brten pa'i sbyin sreg bum khrus/ 'khrul 'khor gyi cho ga rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa mdzad/ rdo rje 'chang gi nye brgyud kyi brgyud 'debs gnyis/ bstod pa la sogs pa'i gzhung bzhi mdzad/ gzhan yang kun mkhyen gung ru/ mnga' ris pa tshul khrims 'od zer/ kun mkhyen rin po che'i sgrub thabs rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi nyams len sbyin sreg mar me'i sbyin sreg tshes bcu'i mchod pa ste mkha' spyod sgo 'byed mdzad/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po/

thar rtse nas nam mkha' dpal bzang / paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po yab sras/ 'dren mchog blo gros chos 'phags/ mang thos klu sgrub/ mkhas grub ngag dbang chos grags/ rje kun dga' grol mchog sngags 'chang thams cad mkhyen pa/ ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ yang rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang / rje dpal ldan rgyal po'i gsung bzhin/ rje bzang po dpal ba'i 'khrid yig sogs mdor na skyes chen rnams kyi bshad sgrub kyi sgo nas dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa'i yig cha sgrub thabs dkyil chog byin rlabs bstod pa bkra shis sogs glegs bam du longs pa du ma yod de/ 'di rnams ni bshad bya'i chos so/ /bshad bya rdo rje phag mo ni/ mtshon bya don gyi rdo rje phag mo/ mtshon byed brda'i rdo rje phag mo'o/ /dang po ni/ rang gi sems gnyis su med pa'i ye shes spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba 'di la rdo rje zhes bya ste/ dper na rdzas kyi rdo rje pha lam gyis phar dngos po thams cad 'joms shing / tshur gang gis kyang gzhig par mi nus pa ltar/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes 'dis kyang phar mtshan rtog thams cad 'joms shing / tshur gang gis kyang gzhig par mi nus/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ sra zhing snying po khog stong med/ /gcad dang gzhig par bya ba med/ /bsreg par byar med 'jig med par/ /stong nyid rdo rjer brjod par bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /phag ni ji ltar phag pas mi gtsang ba ljan ljin sbar sbur thams cad za ba ltar/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes 'dis kyang mtshan rtog thams cad za bar nus pas phag zhes bya'o/ /mo ni mo chags kyis sems can skyed pa bzhin du/ gnas lugs stong pa nyid 'dis kyang / dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad skyed pa'i yum yin pas mo zhes bya ste/ de skad du/ nga ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /yum gyi gzugs kyis skyed par byed/ /ces gsungs/ gnyis pa la/

phyi'i rdo rje phag mo nang gi rdo rje phag mo gnyis las/ dang po ni/ lha sku zhal phyag gi rnam pa can te/ bskyed rim gyi tha mal gyi snang zhen gcod par byed pa rdo rje/ bskyed rim gyis tha mal gyi rnam rtog lha sku zhal phyag gi ngang du za bar nus pas phag gzugs sku bskyed byed yum yin pas na mo zhes bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni gsang ba chos kyi dkyil 'khor gsum ste/ yi ge dang / bdud rtsi dang / rlung gsum la gnad du bsnun pa la brten nas gsal stong bde stong stong nyid bde stong mchog gi ting nge 'dzin gyis gya nom lhar zhen gyi rnam rtog gcod pas na rdo rje/ ting 'dzin des lha zhen gyi rnam rtog za bar nus pas na phag chos sku bskyed byed kyi yum yin pas na mo zhes bya'o/ /de ltar yang / bden gnyis rnam gzhag rdzogs rim dbu ma'i lam/ /sgrib gnyis sbyang phyir brtson pas legs bsgoms pas/ /don gnyis lhun grub 'gyur med bde ba'i thugs/ /mkha' spyod thugs kyi byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /zhes gsungs/ gdams ngag de dag gis bstan pa'i lam nyams su len par byed pa la/ bsgrub bya'i lha/ sgrub byed kyi mngon rtogs/ de ji ltar sgrub pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po bskyed rim phag mo mkha' spyod 'di ni/ dbang bzhi'i don dang ldan pa zab don mthar thug yin te/ dbang bzhi'i don ldan bskyed rim zab mo'i lam/ /thun bzhir bsgom zhing gus pas gsol btab pas/ /sku bzhi dbyer med zung 'jug rdo rje'i sku/ /mkha' spyod sku'i byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /zhes gsungs/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ mkha' 'gro ma yi drwa ba sdom/ /rnal 'byor ma yi legs rdzogs pa/ /rdo rje phag mo'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /'di ni rnal 'byor thams cad kyi/ /snying po'i dkyil 'khor bsdus pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pas/ dbang bzhi'i lam thams cad lha sku zhal phyag gi rnam pa can/ de'i thugs khar 'khor lo lnga brtsegs bsgom pa la tshang bas shin tu zab bo/

/gzhan yang rnal 'byor ma kun spyod las/ de ni he ru ka dpal sprul/ /dag pa chos kyi sprul pa ni/ /phag mo'i gzugs su bstan pa yin/ /thabs dang shes rab sbyor ba las/ /'di nyid dang ni thams cad 'byung / /zhes dang / 'gro ba 'di kun sangs rgyas mnga' bdag nyid/ /gar mkhan dag dang rol mo bzang ltar snang / /gang zhig drug pa zhes bya'i sangs rgyas nyid/ /gcig pu nyid ni du ma'i gar mdzad do/ /zhes dang / rtsa rgyud las/ mkha' 'gro ma ni nyi shu bzhi/ /phag mo yi ni rigs las byung / /zhes gsungs pas/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi bdag nyid du gsungs so/ /yang kun spyod las/ mkha' 'gro ma ni re re bzhin/ /bye ba grangs med dag gis bskor/ /zhes dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ rnal 'byor ma yi skye ba mchog /rtsa yi mchog gi grong khyer du/ /stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyis/ /dbu ma a wa dhu ti'o/ /dbu ma 'di ltar thams cad kyi/ /khyab byed nyid du gnas pas na/ /go 'phang mchog ni gzhal bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pas/ dang por a wa dhu ti/ de las nang skor 'dab ma brgyad mtshams gyi rtsa bzhi las gnyis te rnam shes tshogs brgyad kyi rtsa brgyad/ de re re la sku gsung thugs kyi rtsa gsum gsum/ sngar gyis phyogs kyi rtsa bzhi/ dbu ma dang lnga ste sum cu rtsa bdun/ de las stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis/ de las rgya mtsho'i nang du skar ma shar ba bzhin/ rten la bzhi tshad med grangs med/ 'khor 'das snod bcud thams cad la sbyang gzhi dang sbyong byed dbyer med pa'i tshul gyis g.yogs nas bzhugs pa yin te/ dpal ldan khrag 'thung rgyal po che/ /'dod pa kun gyi dbang phyug gtso/ /kun tu phyag dang zhabs ldan pa/ /kun tu mig dang mgo'i zhal/ /kun tu thos ldan 'jig rten la/ /thams cad g.yogs te rnam par bzhugs/ /de dag kyang bsdu na bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhir 'dus/ de stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis su/

de bdun cu rtsa bdun du/ de nyi shu rtsa bzhir/ de yang brgyad du 'dus te/ la ma dang / gzugs can ma dang / yongs gyur ma dang / byis byas ma dang / mi ldog ma dang / e hi ka dang / tsum 'bi ka dang / rdo rje phag mo rnams so/ /de rnams kyang bsdu na phag mor 'dus te/ rtsa rgyud las/ ya mi ni dang skrag byed ma/ 'od ldan ma dang 'jigs gzugs ma/ /kun tu spyod ma sems ma dang / /bha su ra dang rnam pa bdun/ /sdud pa mo ni 'dir bshad bya/ /zhes 'das pa'i ming ngo / /gzugs can ma dang tsum bi ka /lā ma yongs gyur byis byas mo/ /mi ldog e hi ka lha mo/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni bdun du bshad/ /ces gsungs so/ /de yang sku 'khor gyi phyogs ma bzhi lā mar bsdu/ mtshams ma bzhi gzugs can mar bsdu/ gsung 'khor gyi phyogs ma bzhi yongs gyur mar bsdu/ mtshams bzhi byis byas mar bsdu/ thugs 'khor gyi phyogs ma bzhi mi ldog mar bsdu/ mtshams ma bzhi e hi kar bsdu/ rnal 'byor ma bzhi tsum bi kar bsdu/ sgo mtshams brgyad gtso mor bsdu/ de ltar phag mo ni rigs thams cad kyi sdud byed ma gtso mo yin pas zab bo/ /gnyis pa sgrub byed mngon rtogs kyi sgo nas kyang gzhan las zab ste/ de yang lam 'di nyid ni ltos pa yab la bzhag nas/ ltos chos yum du len pa bya ba smin byed yab las ltos pa'i nyams len khyad par can te/ gsang mtha' la yang lo nag dril gsum gyi nyams len la/ mnyam par bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor dang / ma bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor ro/ /mnyam bzhag la yang bskyed pa'i rim pa dang / rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa la yang / rgyu tshogs gnyis bsags pa dang / 'bras bu lha bskyed pa gnyis te/ de dag gis lam rnams las chung la zab khyad dang ldan zhing lam thams cad tshang ste/ de la tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i bsod nams kyi tshogs ni/ 'dir bla ma spyi bor bsgom zhing gsol ba 'debs pa la tshang zhing zab bo/

/ye shes kyi tshogs ni bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas lus sems thams cad bde chen gyi ye shes su byin gyis brlabs cing / de 'khor 'das snod bcud thams cad la rgyas btab nas bsgom pa la tshang zhing zab bo/ /gnyis pa la 'bras bu lha bskyed pa la/ lo nag dril gsum gyi skabs su nag po pa la 'byung bzhi lugs 'byung las gzhal yas khang bskyed la/ mngon byang lnga las rgyu rdo rje 'chang yab yum bskyed pa yab yum snyoms 'jug gi bde ba sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas thig le las dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog bskyed pa/ lo hi pa la 'byung bzhi sgra tshul dang bcas pa las phyi nang gnyis cig car du bskyed pa/ dril bu pa la skad cig gis phyi'i he ru ka zhal byung la nang la lha drug cu rtsa gnyis bskyed pa'i bskyed chog rnams rtogs rigs yar ldan gyi tshul du tshang zhing / 'dir zab khyad dang ldan pas bskyed chog khyad par 'phags pa yin te/ oṃ gsum ma tshar gcig brjod pa sgra tshul las bskyed pa lo hi pa dang mtshungs/ nyi zla phyag mtshan sa bon rnams mtshon pa yod pas nag po dang / skad cig gis rdo rje rnal 'byor mar bsgom pas dril bu pa dang mtshungs la de rnams re res kyang skye gnas bzhi sbyong ba dang gtso che chung gi khyad par yod pa'ang shes par bya'o/ /'dir skye gnas bzhi cig car sbyong ste/ snying kha'i chos 'byung phyi ma gang du skye ba'i gnas/ gnyis pa ma'i mngal/ zla ba pha'i khams/ saṃ bu ṭir gsungs pa ltar/ zla ba la dmar mdangs yod pas rang chas can nam/ baṃ yig gis mdangs kyis dbus dmar nyams yod pa des ni ma'i khams baṃ yig gis bar srid des mngal skyes sbyong zhing / yang 'khor lo lnga po des skye gnas lhag ma sbyong ste/ chos 'byung gnyis pha ma dang sgong lkog zla ba dmar cha dang bcas pa byang sems gnyis/ baṃ yig snga ma ltar te/ sgong skyes sbyong byed/ 'od zer gyi gong bur gyur pas drod gsher skyes sbyong /

de las rje btsun mar skad cig gis bskyed pas rdzus skyes sbyong / yang na 'od kyi gong bur gyur pas sgong skyes sbyong ste/ gong bu'i bdag nyid du chos mthun pas so gsungs/ 'dis phyi dkyil rgyas pa'i mngon byang lnga yang bsdus te/ 'bras bu ye shes lnga tshang ba'i bskyed chog nyid la mngon byang lnga yang tshang ba yin la/ ye shes lnga ni zla ba'i brdas bstan pa'i me long lta bu'i ye shes/ sngags phreng mnyam nyid ye shes/ baṃ sor rtog ye shes/ 'od zer spro bsdu bya grub ye shes/ skur bzhengs pa chos dbyings ye shes yin no/ /dngos su tshang rtsi ba rang nyid rnal 'byor mar bsgom pa'i snying khar chos 'byung gi nang stong pa ni chos dbyings stong pa nyid las byang chub pa/ zla ba dang dmar chas ni gdan pad nyi las byang chub pa/ sngags phreng gsung yig 'bru las byang chub pa/ e waṃ gzugs bsgrub kyi tshe baṃ gyi yi ge la gri gug so lta bu yod pas thugs phyag mtshan las byang chub pa/ lhar bzhengs pa sku yongs su rdzogs pa las byang chub pa ste lnga tshang ngo/ /ji skad du a bhi na las/ de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /phag mo yi ni bsgrub pa mchog /bskyed pa'i rim pa'i sbyor ba yi/ /bdag nyid bsgom pa rnal 'byor bsgom/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / gzhan yang mkha' 'gro rgya mtshor/ phag mo phyi yi yongs su 'byung / /bskyed pa gang gi bskyed pa lags/ /rang bzhin dang ni ji ltar lags/ /bdag nyid 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan ci/ /'dir ni dgos pa ji ltar lags/ /zhes zhus pa'i lan du/ dbang po dang ni yul thams cad/ /lte ba'i dkyil 'khor rab tu zhugs/ /spyi bor rdo rje gur du ni/ /steng du kha ra rlung 'bab bo/ /'dod chags nyi ma'i dbus su ni/ /skad cig gi ni sprul rtser 'gyur/ /de las bskyed pa'i phag mo ni/ /bha ga lid+ga yi las byung / /bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin las/ /de rnams la ni sngon du bskyed/

/rang bzhin bdag med gcig pu ste/ /mkha' mnyam rnal 'byor gzugs can no/ /rgyu mtshan 'gro ba sgrol ba dang / /snying rje'i gzugs dang bzhin du 'byung / /'dir ni dgos pa gnyis rigs te/ /phyag rgya sbyor ba rab sbyor ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ des na lo nag dril gsum gyi bskyed chog rnams las zab pa'i bskyed chog bstan pa ni/ bla ma 'od du zhu ba'i rkyen gyis lus sems rnams bde chen gyi ye shes su byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin las/ zhes pas bstan te/ de ni sbyang gzhi 'chi ba sbyong zhing chos sku bsgrub pa'i sgrub thabs pho nya lhan skyes so/ /bde chen gyi ye shes de'i ngang nas/ rgyas par na rang gzhan gnyis ka'i gzhi sbyong zhing bsgyur ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang rnal 'byor ma'i skur byas la rang la bsdus te de rnams la bskyed pa dang / rang gzhan gnyis ka'i gzhi sbyong sgyur byas nas bskyed pa dang / bsdus pa ni/ rang gi gzhi sbyong sgyur byas pa dang gsum las/ phyi ma phyag len la mdzad pas/ de'i ngang las e las chos 'byung yig 'bru baṃ yig rnams ni/ bha ga ling ga yi las byung / /zhes pas bstan te/ de yang sbyang gzhi bar srid sbyong zhing longs sku bsgrub pa'i sgrub thabs pho nya zhing skyes so/ /chos 'byung / zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ yig 'bru/ baṃ yig rnams las 'od 'phros gzhi spyod sgyur byas/ lha sku zhal phyag gi rnam par bskyed pa ni/ de rnams la ni sngon du bskyed/ /ces pas bstan te/ de'ang sbyang gzhi skye ba sbyong zhing sprul sku 'grub ba'i pho nya sngags skyes so/ /'o na de ltar bskyed pa'i phag mo'i rang bzhin ji ltar yin snyam na/ rang bzhin bdag med gcig pu ste/ /mkha' mnyam rnal 'byor gzugs can no/ /zhes pa dang / a bhi dha nar/ phag mo'i gzugs ni mtha' yas pas/ /spros dang bral ba'i sdom pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/

rang bzhin chos thams cad kyi sdud byed de kho na nyid do/ /de ltar gnas lugs spros bral de kho na nyid de/ lha sku zhal phyag gi rnam par bsgom pa la rgyu mtshan ci yod snyam na/ rgyu mtshan 'gro ba sgrol ba dang / /snying rje'i gzugs dang gzhan du 'byung / /zhes pas bstan te/ sems can thams cad 'khor ba duḥkha las sgrol ba'i phyir du lha sku zhal phyag gi rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /de ltar bsgom pa la dgos pa ci yod ce na/ mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ste/ de'ang 'dir ni dgos pa gnyis rigs te/ phyag rgya sbyor ba rab sbyor ba'o/ /zhes pas bstan to/ /des na de lta bu'i bskyed chog de/ /rten dkyil 'khor bzhi dang 'khor lo lnga la gnad du bsnun pas zab ste/ dang po dkyil 'khor bzhi la gnad du bsnun pa ni/ lus la rtsa bsam gyis mi khyab rnams chos 'byung / yi ge rnams/ yig 'bru/ bdud rtsi rnams zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ rlung rnams dga' ba 'khyil bar sdom nas gnad du bsnun/ chos 'byung phyi ma lte ba'i 'khor lo/ nang ma gsang gnas kyi 'khor lo/ zla ba'i snying ga'i 'khor lo/ baṃ yig ya ra la wa bzhi mtshon pas mgrin pa'i 'khor lo/ yig 'bru rnams spyi bo'i 'khor lo/ /rtsa 'dab so gnyis mtshon/ de rnams kyang chung chung nyung nyung zhig ma yin/ lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor yin te/ chos kyi 'byung gnas gzhal yas khang / zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dpa' bo rnams/ yi ge so gnyis baṃ yig cha lnga dang bcas pa rnal 'byor ma so bdun no/ /des na sgrub byed mngon rtogs kyi sgo nas zab bo/ /gnyis pa des tshul ji ltar bsgrub pa'i tshul ni lo nag gi skabs su rgyu bde gshegs snying po de nyid/ stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can gyi byang chub sems su bsgyur/ de lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems de la smin byed kyi dbang gi sgo nas dbang gi ye shes su byin gyis brlab/

de ltar brlab pa de nyid sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyis tshul du bskur nas dbang gi ye shes la ngo sprod/ sprad pa'i ye shes de nyid rdo rje 'chang gis/ tha mal snod dang bcud du rab zhen pa'i/ /kun rdzob 'khrul pa'i las snang ma lus kun/ /rnam gzhag lha'i snang bar bsgyur byed pa'i/ /mkha' spyod bskyed rim bsgom par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi/ 'khor 'das snod bcud kyi snang ba phra rags thams cad rang sems kun gzhi skad cig mar bsdus/ de spros bral stong pa nyid du sbyangs/ de'i ngang las chos 'byung zla ba sogs/ de dag las lha sku zhal phyag gi rnam par bsgyur bas zab bo/ /de'ang rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi sgo nas bsgrub pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa gzhung dang sbyar nas bskyed rim 'khor bcas bshad pa ni klad kyi don/ gzhung gi don/ mjug gi don dang gsum las/ dang po klad kyi don la/ mtshan bsgyur ba/ zhar byung lo tsā bas phyag bya ba'o/ /dang po rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra yo gi ni sa dha na/ de bod skad du bsgyur na/ badz+ra rdo rje/ yo gi ni rnal 'byor ma/ sa dha ni sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ dgos don/ bsdus don/ tshig don rnams kyis mchod do/ /gsum pa ni/ theg pa chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa gzhung gi don la rten gyi gdams ngag des nyams su blangs pa'i lam/ lam de nyid nyams su blangs pa las byung ba'i 'bras bu'o/ /dang po/ gzhung las/ dang po re zhig rnal 'byor pas/ /zhes pas bstan la/ rnal 'byor ma kun spyod du yang / dang po re zhig rnal 'byor pa'i dbang phyug /ces gsungs shing / lo hi pa'i rgya gzhung du yang / de ltar du gsungs pas/ de la gnyis te/ slob pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i dbang phyug dang / mi slob pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i dbang phyug go /de'ang rgyud sde 'og ma la ltos nas/ lo nag gi rnal 'byor pa mi slob pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug yin te/

rgyud sde 'og ma rnams kyis lam gyi rtogs rigs yar ldan yin zhing / de dag las khyad par du 'phags so/ /rnal 'byor ma'i rnal 'byor pa la ltos na/ lo nag gi rnal 'byor pa slob pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug yin te/ de dag gi lam rim rtogs rigs yar ldan yin zhing / de dag las rno ba'i lam yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de la slob pa'i rnal 'byor pa ni spros bcas la dga' ba/ mi slob pa'i rnal 'byor pa ni spros med la dga' ba'o/ /rnal 'byor zhes bya ba ni/ lo nag gi rtog rigs yar ldan zhing / 'di'i rnal 'byor bcu gcig nyams su blangs pas ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skyes pa'o/ /pa zhes bya ba ni/ dper na/ rta dang ldan pa la rta pa zhes bya ba/ de bzhin du de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pas na pa zhes bya'o/ /dbang phyug ces bya ba ni/ spyir lo nag dril gsum gyi lam gzhan las khyad par du 'phags shing / bye brag tu rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lam 'di gzhan las zab cing mchog tu gyur pa yin pas/ de nyams su len pa'i rnal 'byor pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gyur pa yin pas dbang phyug ces bya'o/ /rten gyi gang zag gi mtshan nyid gong du bshad zin to/ /thob bya mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi sku thob par byed pa la/ rtogs bya mthar thug de kho na nyid du rtogs dgos/ de la rdzogs rim gyi ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skye dgos/ de la rten bskyed rim dgos/ bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la lha sku zhal phyag gi rnam par bzhengs dgos/ de la bskyed rim rnal 'byor bcu gcig ni sa skya pa chen po'i zhal snga nas/ nyal dang ldang dang bdud rtsi myang / /tshad med bla ma bdag lhar bskyed/ /'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor dang / /dpa' bo dpa' mos byin gyis brlabs/ /ngag bzlas yid bzlas gnyis gcig yin/ /bsam gyis mi khyab rnal 'byor dang / /spyod lam gyi ni rnal 'byor te/ /de ltar rnal 'byor bcu gcig go

/zhes gsungs/ de la dang po nyal dang zhes pa ni/ lha sku zhal phyag gi rnam par bzhengs pa'i sngon du nyal ba'i rnal 'byor dgos te/ de dag gi go rim ni dang po re zhig ces pas bstan no/ /rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi dang po nyal ba'i rnal 'byor la gnyis te/ bskyed rim gyi phyogs la mos pa dang / rdzogs rim gyi phyogs la mos pa'o/ /gnyis po gang ltar na'ang / srod thun la bsgom bzlas byas na thun gzhug tu nyal ba'i rnal 'byor bya/ bsgom bzlas dang ma 'brel na yang skad cig gis nyal ba'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa'o/ /dang po sgrub pa po spros pa la dga' zhing bskyed rim la mos pa che na/ rang nyid gnas khang chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi nang du seng ges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma'i steng du rang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku rgyan dang phyag mtshan spangs pa sha rus sogs gdos bcas ma yin pa 'od kyi rang bzhin du bsgom/ grogs yod na yang de lta bur gsal btab/ rang gi spyi bo'am sngas mgor sngas srung gi tshul du/ seng ges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can rgyan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa zhig gsal btab/ de la gus 'dud drag pos phyag 'tshal gsol ba btab cing blo gtad/ des mtshams sbyar la zhogs g.yas pa 'og tu phab ste nyal lo/ /'di zhu bde lhan skyes bde ba'i ngang la nyal ba yang yin no/ /gnyid sad byung na yang de ltar gsal btab ste nyal lo/ /gnyis pa ni/ sa skya pa chen pos/ bsam mi khyab kyi rnal 'byor dang 'brel nas nyal ba'am/ skad cig gis stong par bsgoms nas nyal ba gang rung gsungs pas bsam mi khyab dang 'brel nas nyal na/ a bhi dha nar spro ba dang bsdu ba byas nas zhes gsungs pas/ rang gi lte ba'i baṃ yig sngags phreng zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yig 'bru rnams las 'od zer 'phros/

khams gsum snod bcud thams cad la phog pas gzugs med khams 'od zer sngon po'i rnam pas lus kyi stod kyi cha la thim/ gzugs khams 'od zer dmar po'i rnam pas bar gyi cha la thim/ 'dod khams 'od zer dkar po'i rnam pas smad kyi cha la thim/ rnal 'byor ma rang yang sku stod sku smad nas rim gyis 'dus te chos 'byung phyi ma la༞ phyi ma nang ma la༞ de zla ba la༞ de sngags phreng la༞ de baṃ yig 'bru bzhi la༞ de zla tshes la༞ de thig le la༞ de nā da la thim mthar gnyid du 'gro khar nā da yang je phrar song ste nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar spros bral de kho na nyid kyi ngang la rnam rtog gzhan gyis bar ma chod par byas nas nyal te/ 'di rang bzhin lhan skyes stong pa'i ngang du nyal ba yang yin no/ /a bhi dha nar/ chos rnams kun gyi chos nyid bsgom/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rnal 'byor gnyis pa ldang ba'i rnal 'byor la gnyis te/ bskyed rim gyi ngang la nyal ba'i ldang lugs dang / rdzogs rim gyi ngang la nyal ba'i ldang lugs so/ /de dag la bzhi ste/ rgyu gang ldang /rkyen gang gis/ tshul ji ltar/ ngo bo gang ldang ba'o/ /dang po bskyed rim gyi ngang la nyal ba'i ldang lugs kyi rgyu ni/ mdang gi lha sku'i rnam pa de las so/ /rkyen ni sngas mgo'i rdo rje chos kyi nam mkhar ḍā ma ru'i sgra oṃ gsum ma'i sngags su grags pa'o/ /las dang po pas gnyid kyi ngang du de dran pa mi yong na'ang / gnyid sad ma thag tu des bskul nas ldang ba yin no snyam du mos pa byas pas/ goms na gnyid sad khar de dran pa 'byung ngo gsung / tshul ni skad cig gis chu la nya 'phar ba'i tshul gyis bya'o/ /ngo bo phyag mtshan med pa'i rnal 'byor ma'i skur lam ste langs te/ rang nyid lhar gsal ba dang / mdun gyi bla ma dwangs pa gsal ba'i ngang nas gnas khang la bltas pas dag gsal gnyis med kyi ngo bo chos 'byung dmar po dang / grogs sogs ni rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal btab/

mdun gyi bla ma la mos gus ched du byas pas 'od du zhu rang la thim pas rang nyid sngar bas kyang gsal bar bsam/ de yang a bhi dha nar/ rang gi lhag pa'i lhar sbyor ba'i/ /zhes gsungs/ sems can thams cad kyang rnal 'byor ma'i skur bsgom nus na khyad par 'phags te/ sems can kun la rab brtags bya/ /zhes gsungs/ gnyis pa rdzogs rim gyi ngang la nyal ba'i ldang lugs kyi rgyu ni/ mdang gi chos nyid bsam gyis mi khyab de las so/ /rkyen ni mkha' spyod kyi dpa' bo dpa' mo rnams kyis nam mkhar ḍā ma ru'i sgra oṃ gsum ma'i sngags su 'khrol te byung ba'o/ /tshul ni chu las nya 'phar gyi tshul bya ba'am/ yang na bsam mi khyab de las nā dar ldang / de nas thig le nas rnal 'byor ma'i skur bsgom pa'i bar gyis ldang ngo / /ngo bo phyag mtshan med pa'i rnal 'byor ma'i skur langs te/ sems can thams cad rnal 'byor ma'i skur bsgom pa sngar bzhin no/ /ldang ba'i dus tshod ni nam gyi bzhi cha'ang brgyad cha nas ldang bar 'dod gsung / de dag gi sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod na/ snod kyi 'jig rten 'jig pa/ zhig nas stong pa/ bcud kyi sems can 'chi ba la phra rags gnyis te/ rags pa'i 'chi rim/ sa chu la thim/ chu me la༞ me rlung la༞ rlung rnam par shes pa la thim pa na rags pa'i 'chi rim mo/ /rnam par shes pa snang ba la thim/ snang ba mched pa la thim/ mched pa thob pa la thim/ thob pa 'od gsal la thim pa ni phra ba'i 'chi rim ste/ snod kyi 'jig rten zhig pa de 'jig 'gyur/ sngar bcud kyi sems can shi ba/ da 'jig 'gyur gyi bar rtog pa'i snang ba dang bcas pa thams cad dang rang gzhan thams cad dge sbyor gyis rtsis ma zin pa'i tha mal gyi nyal ldang rnams kyang yin gsungs/ sbyong byed ni de thams cad 'dir bsgom pa'i kun gzhi rang sems skad cig ma gcig tu gyur/ de spros bral de kho na nyid bsam gyis mi khyab kyi ngang du bshig nas bsgom la/

de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ de yang pho nya gsum bsres kyi tshul du nyams su len te/ rang gi dmigs pa'i sgo nas bsgom pa de pho nya sngags skyes/ de'ang yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i zhing skyes sprul sku'i ting nge 'dzin las gzhan ma yin te/ zhing skyes de'ang 'og min gyi pho nya lhan skyes kyi ting nge 'dzin las gzhan ma yin la/ de'ang chos kyi sku las gzhan ma yin no snyam du bsgom mo/ /'chi ba chos skur ngo sprod pa'o/ /shi nas chos skur ngo 'phrod na ma rig pas rgyu byas/ bag chags kyis rkyen byas te/ 'od gsal las thob par langs/ thob pa mched par langs pa sogs rim gyis langs te sgo dgu gang rung nas thon te bar do 'byung ba de sbyong byed/ de nas gnyid du song ba'i gnas skabs su nyin bar gyi bag chags rmi lam sna tshogs 'byung ba rnams rmi lam du rang ngo shes par byas la/ longs spyod rdzogs skur ngo sprod/ pho nya gsum bsres sngar bzhin/ yang sngar skyes pa dang skye 'gyur gyi bar rtog pa'i snang ba dang bcas pa thams cad ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyi sems skad cig mar bsdu/ de rnal 'byor ma'i skur ldang / de sprul skur ngo sprad/ de la pho nya gsum bsre tshul sngar ltar nyams su blangs te/ sbyang gzhi skye 'chi bar do gsum mo/ /sbyong byed nyal ba dang / gnyid du song ba dang / ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gsum gyi sbyang 'bras sku gsum ngo sprod pa yin te/ 'chi ba zhes bya chos sku ste/ /bar srid longs spyod rdzogs pa dang / /'gro ba drug sogs sprul pa ste/ /zhes gsungs/ 'di dag la goms nas rmi lam sbyong bsgyur spel ba'i gnad kyang kha bskang na legs sam snyam mo/ /'o na sbyang gzhi skye 'chi bar do gsum 'og lha bskyed pa'i skabs su'ang 'byung bas lan mang po zlos pa'i skyon med dam snyam na med de sbyang gzhi gtso che ba rnams sbyong byed du mas sbyong dgos pa'i phyir/

rang bzhin gyi dus gsum gyi skye 'chi la thug pa yang med pa'i phyir ro gsungs/ de ltar ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyis langs nas ci byed na bsam gtan bsgom pa la 'jug pas so/ /'dir bdud rtsi 'og nas 'byung ba ltar myang bsrung ba'i mchog kyang yin gsung / de nas go cha gsal 'debs pa dang tsham rngam sngags kyis bsrung ba bya ba dang / dga' ba gsum gsal 'debs bsngo ba smon lam rnams bya ste de rnams srod thun gyi mjug bsdu yin gsung / bsnyen mtshams lta bu'i gang ltar skabs 'dir snga thun gyi thugs dam 'chag med gzhan dgos pa yod na'ang byas la thun mtshams kyi bya ba ci dgos pa grub bo/ /bsam gtan gyi grogs su 'gro zhing khrus byed par spro na dbang lha spyan drangs mchod cing gsol btab la/ chu gtsang ma'am/ 'dir rnal 'byor bla med yin pas dri chu 'bru gsum gyi byin gyis rlabs pa'am/ bum chus dbang gis skabs ltar gtso bo'i thugs kha nas sgo mtshams ma brgyad byon te bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhis rdo rje'i glu len/ khaṇ+ḍa kā pā li la sogs pa'i dpa' bo rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ rab tu gtum mo la sogs pa'i dpa' mo rnams kyis mchod pa byas/ sgo mtshams brgyad kyis bgegs bskrad par bsam dngos su khrus bya zhing / yi ge brgya pa 'don dbang bzhi chu rgyun gcig la thob par bsam/ sgrub pa'i cho ga bsre ba dang rigs bdag bsam pa ni mi dgos so/ /gnas skabs gzhan du yang / gdong bkru ba dang / skra bkru ba sogs la yang khrus kyi rnal 'byor 'di'ang khyad par med do/ /mi spro zhing bsam gtan gyi grogs su mi 'gro na ma byas kyang nyes pa med do/ /de nas bsam gtan bsgom pa la gnas la sogs pa ni bshad zin to/ /gsum pa bdud rtsi myang ba ni tho rangs ni ldang ba'i rjes thogs de ma thag nas myang la thun phyi ma gsum la thun la 'jug pa'i gong 'dir ram/

'og rdor sems kyi bsgom bzlas tshar nas myang ba yang 'dug pas gang ltar yang bdud rtsi ril bu yod na gsum mam gnyis sam gcig 'bru gsum gyis myang / med na bur chang ngam/ nas chang byin rlabs rgyas par byed na/ lo dril gyi skabs ltar bya/ 'bring rdo rje 'chang gi gtor chog bzhin/ bsdu na 'bru gsum gyis myangs byin gyis brlabs la/ dag bya lus ngag yid gsum/ dag byed rdzas sngags dang ting nge 'dzin gsum gyi lam brten nas/ dga' ba gsum ldan du ldang ste/ lha sku zhal phyag gi rnam par ldang ba ni sku'i dga' ba'am dag pa mgrin pa 'od dpag med kyi gnas su bdud rtsi myang ba gsung gi dga' ba'am dag pa/ de'ang bdud rtsi myang lugs ni snying kha'i baṃ yig mchod pa'i bsam pas 'bru gsum gyis myangs te mgrin pa na ya ra la wa'i rtsa bzhi yod pas/ der dwangs ma dpag tu med pa 'phel bas/ lus thams cad la khyab/ khyad par snying kha'i baṃ yig dmar po ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin can la bdud rtsi phul bas lus sems bde chen gyi ye shes su byin gyis brlabs/ baṃ yig nyi ma bye ba'i gzi brjid dang ldan bsam pa ni thugs kyi dga' ba'am dag pa yin no/ /bdud rtsi sbyong myang ba'i sbyang gzhi/ 'dod sred kyis kun nas bslangs te dus gsum gyi dkor zas lha'i bdud rtsi dud 'gro rnams kyi kha zas sogs mdor na bza' btung gi snang ba ji snyed pa rnams yin no/ /sbyong byed 'dir bdud rtsi myang ba'i rnal 'byor du bsgyur nas dag pa'i snang bas rgyas 'debs pa yin no/ /sbyangs 'bras rig pa 'dzin pa'am 'od dpag med kyi go 'phang thob byed do/ /de lta bu'i nyal ba dang ldang ba dang bdud rtsi myang ba rnams 'og gi bsam mi khyab pa'i gzhung gis bstan no/ /bzhi pa tshad med pa bzhi bsgom pa ni/ gzhung las sems can thams cad 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las bsgral nas rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi bde ba la dgod par bya'o/

/zhes tshad med pa'i rnal 'byor sngon du 'gro bas bya'o/ /zhes gsungs/ de la tshad med bzhi bsgom pa'i sngon du skyabs 'gro bya ba/ de nas tshad med bzhi bsgom pa dngos/ rgyas par na rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas bya ba'o/ /de dag gi rgyu mtshan lam log pa las khyad par du bya ba skyabs 'gro'i 'khrid/ dman pa las khyad par du bya ba sems bskyed kyi 'khrid/ 'gal rkyen sdig pa sbyang ba yi ge brgya pa'i 'khrid do/ /de gsum gyis sgrub pa po'i rgyud kyi sdom pa gsum gyi bslab pa yar ldan du bya ba ste/ so thar gyi sdom pa yar ldan du bya ba'i phyir skyabs 'gro/ byang sems kyi sdom pa yar ldan du bya ba'i phyir sems bskyed sngags sdom yar ldan du bya ba'i phyir/ rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas so/ /mdor na dngos gzhi bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len byed pa la sngon 'gro sdom gsum gyi bslab pa shin tu dag pa gcig dgos pas/ de yang nyes ltung chen po byung na slar yang dbang bskur ba blang dgos shing / thun mtshams kyi nyes ltung phra mo rnams sngon 'gro 'di gsum byas pas dag par 'gyur ro/ /de skad du slob dpon 'jam dpal grags pas/ sdom gsum cho gar mi ldan par/ /sngags pa'i bdag nyid mi 'gyur te/ /ces dang / dang por so so thar pa yi/ /sdom pa legs par ma bzung bar/ /gsang ba tshogs tshul gnas byed pa/ /tha ba las 'bras bskyed bzhin no/ /rtsa ba rnyed par mi 'gyur bas/ /dang por skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te/ /sdom gsum cho ga rab tu brtag /ces gsungs/ de ltar sdom gsum dag par byas pas bskyed rdzogs kyi ting nge 'dzin skye ba sogs dgos pa dpag tu med pa yod de/ sdom gsum cho gar rab tu brtag /de ltar sngags pa tshul ldan pas/ /dngos grub la ni dogs med de/ /bstan pa sangs rgyas sogs bstod cing / /lha sogs 'jig rten kun gyis bskur/ /zhes so/

/dang po skyabs 'gro ni/ rnam gzhag rgyas par na/ rgyu yul tshul dang phan yon dang / /bslab bya sgra don dbye ba'o/ /zhes pa'i don shes dgos la/ 'dir mdor bsdus te bshad na/ gang la skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul/ skyabs su 'gro mkhan gyi gang zag skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshul gsum las/ dang po skyabs yul gsal gdab pa ni/ rang gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs 'di nyid tha mal gyi snang ba thams cad dbyings su thim pa'i ngang las zhing yongs su dag pa bai ḍūr+ya'i sa gzhi lag mthil ltar mnyam pa la gser gyi mig mangs ris su bris pa/ mnan na nem byed pa/ btegs na phar byed pa/ reg na phun sum tshogs pa'i bde ba skyed pa/ de'i dbus su rang gi smin mtshams kyi thad tsam du slebs pa'i mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ge chen po brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri'i dbus su rtsa ba'i bla ma 'khor lo bde mchog gi rnam pa can la thugs gsung sku'i lha/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyis bskor ba/ gtso bo'i rgyab khaṇ+ḍa ro hi'i mdun du chos po ti brag ri brtsigs pa lta bu gsal btab/ de yang gtso bo ni bla ma dang sangs rgyas dkon mchog gi rang bzhin chos po ti ni chos dkon mchog 'khor rnams dge 'dun dkon mchog gi rang bzhin du bsam la skyabs 'gro byed pa'i tshe/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la zhes pa'i tshe gtso bo la dmigs pa gtad/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhes pa'i tshe'ang gtso bo la dmigs/ dam pa'i chos rnams la zhes ba'i tshe chos po ti la dmigs/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun zhes ba'i tshe 'khor gyi lha tshogs la dmigs pa gtad/ skyabs 'gro bsdu ba'i tshe bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che sogs kyis gsol ba btab pas skyabs yul rnams las 'od zer 'phros rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la phog nas mi dmigs par bzhag pa gang bde bya zhes pa'i bar 'og nas 'byung ba ltar bsam/ de nas gtso bo bla ma 'od sngon por zhu/

rang gi snying khar thim thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs par bsam/ chos po ti 'od dmar por zhu/ mgrin par thim/ gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs par bsam/ 'khor gyi lha rnams 'od dkar por zhu/ dpral bar thim/ sku'i byin rlabs zhugs par bsam de dag ni dngos grub blang ba zhes bya'o/ /de rnams skyabs 'gro'i dmigs pa lugs gcig go /yang na smin mtshams kyi thad kar seng khri pad nyi 'jigs byed dus mtshan dang bcas pa'i steng na skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rnam pa rgyan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa/ de'i spyi bor pad zla'i steng na rnam snang he ru ka sku mdog dkar po g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum phyag g.yas pas 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa dang g.yon pas 'khor los yu ba byas ba'i dril bu bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa gsal btab la dpal ldan bla ma zhes pa'i tshe rnam snang la dmigs pa gtad/ de bzhin du/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhes pa'i tshe baṃ yig 'khor lo lnga brtsegs la/ dam pa'i chos rnams la zhes pa'i tshe sngags phreng dang gsung la/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun pa'i tshe sku la dmigs pa gtad/ bsdu ba'i tshe sku las 'od zer 'phros rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la phog pas de rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa thams cad sbyangs/ lus 'od kyi gong bu re rer gyur/ de yang mkha' spyod ma'i skur gyur te mkha' spyod la bya khyu 'phur ba ltar song bar bsam pa'am/ mi dmigs par bzhag pa gang bde bya sems can rnams la dkon mchog gi byin rlabs bstim pa 'di gong 'og gnyis char du shes par bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma de 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas dkon mchog gi byin rlabs rang la zhugs par bsam/ yang skyabs yul lugs gcig la/ mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma rje btsun rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can du bzhugs pa la skyabs gnas kun tshang ba yin te/

bla ma thams cad thugs yid gcig pa bla ma kun 'dus kyi ngo bo yin pas so/ /de nyid kyi phung po rgyal ba rigs lnga yin pas sangs rgyas kun 'dus/ thugs rgyud la bzhugs pa'i spangs rtogs kyi yon tan rnams chos༞ phyi nang gi skye mched rnams sems dpa' sems ma'i ngo bo yin pas dge 'dun༞ mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams bka' nyan gsung bstod kyi tshul du gnas pas mkha' 'gro chos skyong yang tshang / de ltar shes par byas nas skyabs 'gro drug bskor bya ba'am/ bzhi skor byed na/ dpal ldan bla ma zhes pa'i tshe sku la dmigs/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhes pa'i tshe thugs kha'i baṃ yig dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dang / phung po lnga'i sangs rgyas rnams la dmigs/ dam pa'i chos rnams zhes pa'i tshe thugs kha'i sngags phreng dang sku'i rtsa 'khor yig 'bru rnams la dmigs so/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun zhes pa'i tshe skye mched kyi rtsa 'khor rnams la dmigs so/ /bsdu ba'i tshe bla ma'i sku las 'od zer sogs gong dang 'dra/ bla ma de yang yas gtsug tor nas mas seng khri nas rim gyis 'od du zhu nas snying kha'i thad du 'od rdza ma tsam gcig bsam/ 'od de rang gi spyi gtsug nas thim pas lus ngag yid gsum bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dang dbyer med du bsam la mnyam bzhag bya/ de dag ni skyabs yul rgyas bsdus dmigs pa ngo sprod lugs dang bcas pa'o/ /gnyis pa skyabs su 'gro mkhan gyi gang zag ni/ rang nyid kyi g.yas su rtsa ba'i pha/ g.yon du rtsa ba'i ma/ mdun du dgra 'dre mtha' skor du rigs drug bar do dang bcas pa ston mo chen mo la khrom tshogs pa lta bur khrigs mer gang bar bsam/ gsum pa skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshul ni/ bla ma la lam gyi 'dren pa/ sangs rgyas la lam gyis ston pa/ chos la lam dngos/ dge 'dun la lam gyi zla grogs zhu snyam pa'i sgo nas rang nyid kyis 'go drangs nas thams cad kyang skyabs 'gro byed pa'i sgra dir ri rir byed par bsam zhing /

sems can gyi don du rang nyid dkon mchog gi go 'phang myur du thob pa zhig bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen snyam pas skyabs 'gro brgya rtsa stong rtsa sogs byed pa'i bar la kha tsam tshig tsam ma yin par snying khongs rus pa'i gting nas khyed shes khyed mkhyen skyabs mgon re sa gzhan med snyam du dkon mchog gsum la blo lings te bkal ba'i/ go cha dgos te/ dper na khang pa'am brag gi phug la char skyob pa'i nus pa yod kyang yid gnyis the tshom byas nas der ma song na/ kha nas khang pa dang brag phug lan brgyar bzlas kyang char pas brdung ba la mi phan pa bzhin no/ /des na skyabs yul rnams kyi rgyu lus kyi chos thams cad lag mthil du skyu ru ra bzhag pa ltar mkhyen pas na mkhyen pa'i spyan yang mnga'/ sems can thams cad la bu gcig po shi ba ltar mi bzod pa'i thugs rje yod pas brtse ba yang mnga'/ mkhyen pa dang brtse ba yod kyang nus pa med na ma lag zha ma'i bu chus khyer ba bzhin skyob mi nus pa la/ rdzu 'phrul gyi nus pa yang tshad med pa mnga' bas bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la yid gnyis dang the tshom spangs te/ sgo gsum 'jug pa rtse gcig tu dril te skyabs su song na phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab cing sdug bsngal rgyu bcas las skyob nus pa yin no/ /tshad med pa'i rnal 'byor dngos ni/ sems bskyed dang tshad med rgyu lus su song ba dang / de gnyis ngo bo gcig tu song ba dang gnyis las/ dngos gzhi 'phags pa rin po che'i sgrub thabs su gsungs la/ phyi ma ni nā ro ta pa dang / sa chen gyi gzhung du 'byung ba de bzhin bya gsungs pas/ gnyis pa sems bskyed ni/ smon 'jug gi go don spyi dang mthun zhing 'dir rnal 'byor bcu gcig nang tshan bzhi pa tshad med kyi rnal 'byor te sa skya pa chen pos/ bdag gi rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi go 'phang thob par byas la/ sems can thams cad srid pa'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las bsgral bar bya'o/

/zhes bsams te de la tshad med bzhi tshang ngo / /zhes gsungs pas/ rgyas par gzhan ltar mi bhaiṃ zhing / bsdus pa 'di tsam la'ang tshad med bzhi tshang ba yin te/ sems can thams cad blo yul du byas pas btang snyoms tshad med/ srid pa 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las bsgral zhes pas sems can thams cad la brtse ba mi bzod pa'i snying rje skye bas na snying rje tshad med/ snying rje'i chu ba byams pa ste zhes gsungs pa ltar snying rje'i shugs las sdug bsngal dang bral 'dod kyi blo skye bas byams pa/ thams cad byang chub kyi bde ba la dgod snyam pa dga' ba tshad med do/ /zhes rje mus pa'i gsungs la/ zin bris la lar tshad med bzhi tshang tshul ni sems can thams cad la bu gcig pa ltar brtse ba ni byams pa tshad med/ 'di rnams sdug bsngal las bsgral/ rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang la dgod snyam pa snying rje tshad med/ de la brten nas bdag rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang thob pa la dga' snyam pa dga' ba tshad med/ rnal 'byor ma'i thugs rjes nye ring med pa skyong ba btang snyoms tshad med yin zhes 'byung ngo / /gsum pa rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas ni/ bla ma brgyud pa'i phyag len la/ ma rgyud pa rnams kyi a bhi dha nar bshad pa'i he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pa'i bsgom bzlas dang / pha rgyud pa rnams kyi de dang cha 'dra ba'i rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas bya ba tshogs 'khor gsang ba kun brgyan las bshad pas 'dir he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pa'i bsgom bzlas bya ba la rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i spyi bor lha bsgom pa/ de'ang rdo rje sems dpa' che chung rang gi mtho tshad tsam bsgom pa bla ma rnams kyi gsung sgros yin/ gsung sngags bzla ba/ bshags sdom bya ba rnams bsgom don mtha' dpyod dang bcas pa'i bshad pa rgyas par kun mkhyen chen pos mdzad pa'i/ kyai rdor man ngag lugs kyi rnam bshad sogs su shes par bya'o/

/de ltar sngon 'gro rnam pa gsum gyi sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprad pa ni/ de la skyabs 'gro'i sbyang gzhi/ yul mtho dman 'bring gsum skyabs mi 'os pa la skyabs su song ba/ blun po yi dwags la yang skyabs 'gro zhing / /brtse med sdig can mi la'ang skyabs 'gro med/ /de dag mkhas pa snying rje can rnams kyi/ /skyabs gnas ma yin snying rje'i yul nyid yin/ /zhes pa ltar skyabs gnas log pa la brten nas sdig pa bsags pa ji snyed dang / so thar gyi nyes ltung thams cad yin/ sbyong byed skyabs 'gro'i rnal 'byor/ sbyangs 'bras dkon mchog gi go 'phang thob pa'o/ /sems bskyed kyi sbyang gzhi ni/ dug gsum gyi kun nas bslangs te sems can la gnod 'tshe nye ring chags sdang byas pa la sogs pa'i bag chags rtog snang dang bcas pa thams cad sbyong byed tshad med bzhi'i ngo bor bsgyur/ sbyangs 'bras rje btsun ma'i go 'phang thob pa'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas kyi sbyang gzhi/ dus gsum gyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi mi dge ba dang rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa'i nyes ltung mtha' dag yin/ sbyong byed lha bsgom pa/ sngags bzla ba sogs de dang de'i ngo bo rang sems skad cig ma gcig la bsdu/ sbyangs 'bras rdo rje sems dpa'i go 'phang thob pa'o/ /lnga pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa bsod nams kyi tshogs bsog pa maṇ+ḍal gyi 'khrid dang bcas pa ni gzhung las/ de nas rang gi bla ma bsgom par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa sa skya pa chen pos/ nam mkha' rin po che'i khri la bla ma sku dar la bab pa'i cha lugs can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga thod pa 'dzin pa bsam la/ de la bla ma dkon mchog gsum gyi rang bzhin yin snyam du dran zhing gus 'dud drag po bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ bskyed rim gyi ting nge 'dzin skye ba la bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po gcig bsag dgos pas/

de la 'og ma rnams kyi rtogs rigs yar ldan pa'i tshogs rgya chen po gcig bsag pa la/ tshogs bsag pa'i rten 'og ma rnams kyi rten gyi gang zag zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa 'dir zhal gcig phyag gnyis par bsdu/ tshogs bsag pa'i yul bla ma gcig pur bsdu/ bsag pa'i tshul phyag dang mchod pa byed pa rnams 'dir bla ma la phur tshugs su gsol ba 'debs pa la bsdu/ de'ang bla ma rdo rje chos dang / dpa' bo rdo rje chos gnyis las phyi ma bsgom pa sa skya pa chen pos bshad cing de ltar du bsgom/ 'o na bla ma gcig pu la gsol ba 'debs pa tshogs bsag pa'i yul bzang ba'i rgyu mtshan ci yin snyam na/ rtsa rgyud las/ de nas sgrub pos dngos kun gyi/ /dang por slob dpon mnyes par bya/ /sgrub 'dod shin tu mnyam bzhag par/ /ci nus pas ni bla ma mchod/ /ces dang / sdom 'byung las/ bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos/ /bla ma dge 'dun de bzhin te/ /sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /mkha' 'gro ma'i drwa ba'i sdom/ /sangs rgyas go 'phang 'dod pa yi/ /de phyir bla ma mnyes par bya/ /zhes dang / dril bu pas/ bla ma'i byin rlabs tsam gyis ni/ /skad cig nyid la 'byung gang yin/ /zhes dang / ha ri pas/ gang gi drin gyi bde chen ni/ /skad cig nyid la thob 'gyur ba/ /bla ma rin chen lta bu yis/ /zhes dang / slob dpon klu sgrub kyi/ ri dbang rtse nas 'ga' zhig lhung gyur na/ /ltung bar mi 'gyur snyam yang ltung bar 'gyur/ /bla ma'i drin gyi phan pa'i lung thob na/ /grol bar mi gyur snyam yang grol bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / mchod pa thams cad spangs nas ni/ /bla ma mchod par bya ba'o/ /de mnyes pas ni kun mkhyen gyi/ /ye shes mchog ni thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs shing / gzhan yang mdo rgyud bstan bcos thams cad nas mchog thun mong gi dngos grub sgrub pa la bla ma dam pa bsngags pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa gcig gsungs so/

/bla ma'i rnal 'byor ji ltar bsgom pa'i tshul ni/ rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas nyams su blang na/ rang sems dang rdor sems bsres pa'i stong nyid de'i ngang las rang rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i smin mtshams kyi thad kyi mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dpa' bo rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can bskyed cing gsol ba btab pa ni thun mong ba yin la/ thun mong ma yin pa ni sngar gyi gdan gyi steng du ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam pa sangs rgyas rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon dril bu thugs khar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i dkyil mo dkrung gis bzhugs pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor cog can/ gzhon nu lo bcu drug lon pa lta bu'i na tshod dang ldan pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang / rus pa'i rgyan drug rin po che'i phra tshom du ma yod pas brgyan pa/ 'od zer dpag med 'phro ba dang gsal la rnyog pa med pa bdag la dges bzhin du bzhugs pa/ de'i mdun nas brtsams te g.yon bskor du gdan de 'dra ba re re'i steng du sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang nas bzung ste rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du/ byon pa'i brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad dpa' bo rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can gyi mtha' skor du bzhugs par bsam pa'am/ /yang na gtso bo dang 'dra bar bsgoms kyang chog yang na rnal 'byor pa rnams rnal 'byor pa'i cha lugs can dang / dge bsnyen rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams na bza' dkar po'i cha lugs can dang / dge tshul dang dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams rab byung chos gos rnam gsum can du bsgoms kyang chog gsungs pas/ de rnams gang mos bya'o/ /de'i mthar g.yon bskor gyi rim ba bzhin yi dam rgyu sde bzhi'i lha tshogs dang de'i mthar sangs rgyas byang sems nyan thos rang rgyal chos bsrung nor lha dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams rgyan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa rnam pa gsal ba sprin phung 'thibs pa ltar bzhugs par bsam/

de thams cad kyi dbral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par aḥdamar po/ thugs khar hūm̐ sngon po de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos srung nor lha'i tshogs dang bcas pa spyan drangs par bsam la oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya bya/ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod pas/ yul so so la rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong nor lha'i tshogs dang bcas pa cha tshang re re thim pas thams cad skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor gyur par bsam/ spyan drangs pa'i yul la kun snying gi de nyid 'dus pa'i 'grel pa de nyid snang chen du/ sangs rgyas kyi yul gnyis bshad pa'i dang por/ 'og min du longs sku chos sku dbyer med du bzhugs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yul gcig yin pa nas spyan drangs pa dang / gnyis pa ni gdul bya sems can gang gnas pa'i sa der sangs rgyas de'i don mdzad nas bzhugs pa ni sangs rgyas kyi yul rang bzhin gyi gnas zhes brjod de/ de spyan drangs na rang gang na yod pa na sangs rgyas bzhugs kyang snang ba ma dag pas ma mthong ba yin pas rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyi ma dag pa bsal zhing sangs rgyas mngon sum du gzigs par bsam/ zhes nyag bre yon tan 'od zer gyi bde mchog lo hi pa'i rnam bshad du 'byung ngo / /de nas blo snying brang gsum spyi bo'i mthil bzhi lings kyi bkal te sems rtse gcig tu skyid sdug legs nyes gang byung yang khyed shes khyed mkhyen snyam pas/ gang gi drin gyi bde chen nyid/ /ces sogs dang / 'di'i brgyud 'debs ni/ rdo rje 'chang chen rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /zhes sogs kyi gsol 'debs ngag nas 'don zhing mtho gtong dma' gtong khyed shes khyed mkhyen snyam pa'i gsol ba drag tu 'debs/ de nas rang nyid la chags pa skye ba'i yul yid du 'ong ba'i dngos po khang zhing zas nor longs spyod gnyen bshes la sogs pa nye bar mkho ba'i dngos po thams cad bla ma la phul bas bla mas bdag gir mdzad pas chags pa'i rnam rtog thams cad rang grol du song bar bsam/

de bzhin du zhe sdang skye ba'i yul gnod byed dgra 'dre dang mi dang mi ma yin pa'i dgra 'dre byur gsum thams cad bla ma la phul bas bla mas bdag gir mdzad pas zhe sdang gi rnam rtog thams cad rang grol du song bar bsam/ yang gti mug skye ba'i yul phan gnod gang yang med pa'i btang snyoms pa bar ma'i 'gro ba rnams bla ma la phul bas bla ma'i bdag gir mdzad nas gti mug gi rnam rtog thams cad rang grol du song bar bsam/ de nas ku sa li'i tshogs bsogs ni/ rang rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i snying khar sems nyid kyi ngo bo baṃ yig de nyid rnal 'byor ma mtshon gang pa gcig tu gyur te dbu ma'i lam nas yar song spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga rgya mthong kha bye ba lta bu nas mthon/ mdun gyi rtsa ba'i bla ma dang zhal sbyor du bzhugs pas phan tshun gyi rgyud la bde chen gyi ye shes skyes par bsam/ rang sems kyi rnal 'byor ma des slar phyir mig bltas pas rang gi phung po de che la snum pa tsho bar 'dug pa gzigs nas/ sngar 'di lta bu'i lus ji snyed gcig blangs pa don med du song 'dug da lan don can du bya'o snyam pas phung po'i sar byon te/ gri gug gi smin 'tshams sna ba ltag pa rnams su/ reg tsam re byas pas thod pa de bog yong la khad song ba/ phyag gis blangs te rang bzhin gyi grub pa'i rlung dkyil me dkyil thod pa'i sgyid bu gsum gyi steng du bzhag de yang phyi dkar la nang dmar ba stong gsum gyi khyon dang mnyam par bsam/ lag na yod pa'i gug gis rkang pa g.yon pa dum bu gsum du btub nas thod pa'i nang du bskyur/ de bzhin du rkang ba g.yas lag pa gnyis nang khrol don snying rnams dang / mgo bo'i lhag ma yang bskyur bas sha'i ri bo khrag gi rgya mtsho rus pa'i gral phrul dang bcas pas gang ba'i thod par bsam/ 'og nas me rang 'bar du byung bas de rnams khol zhing lud pas zag med kyi bdud rtsi kha dog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa dri zhim pa ro mngar ba reg bya bsil ba/

nus pa shi nas zhag lnga song ba yang sos nus pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsam la/ rang rnal 'byor mar gsal bas mkha' 'gro spyi gtor ltar byin rlabs bya ba'am/ yang na 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis rlabs nas/ rang gi snying kha nas rang 'dra ba'i rnal 'byor ma g.yas thod pa chung ba dang g.yon che ba 'dzin ba dpag med spros mdun gyi bdud rtsi nas g.yas kyi bcus g.yon du blugs te mdun gyi gtso bo rtsa ba'i bla ma la mchod pas zhal du lan gsum gsol bas ljags rdo rje'i 'od kyi sbu gu can gyis gsol te thugs rgyud zag med kyi bde bas gang bas bdag la shin tu mnyes nas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad da lta nyid du stsol ba'i bdag nyid can du bsam zhing drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ slar mchod ba'i lha mo rang la bsdu yang snying kha nas mchod pa'i lha mo spros/ thod pas bdud rtsi bcus te brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi zhal du phul bas zag med kyi bde bas thugs rgyud gang bdag la shin tu mnyes nas/ bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes da lta nyid du stsol ba'am bdag nyid can du bsam/ lha mo rnams tshur 'dus te rang la thim/ yang snying kha nas lha mo spros/ thod pas bdud rtsi bcus te/ yi dam lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas byang sems nyan thos rang rgyal dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos srung nor lha rnams sprin phung 'thibs pa bzhin bzhugs pa rnams kyi zhal du phul bas de thams cad thugs rgyud zag med kyi bde bas gang mchog thun mong gi dngos grub stsol bar bsam/ lha mo rnams tshur bsdus/ yang snying kha nas lha mo spros/ dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga rnams yi dam gyi lhar gsal ba la mchod/ chos sgrub pa'i grogs mdzad par bsam/ lha mo bsdus/ yang snying kha nas lha mo spros/ thod pas bdud rtsi bcus te gnas bdag gzhi bdag rnams la phul bas zag med kyi bde bas rgyud gang zhing rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur nas bdag gi byang chub bsgrub pa'i grogs byed par bsam lha mo bsdus/

yang spros te rigs drug bar do dang bcas ba'i sems can la sbyin pas thams cad kyi bu lon sha mkhon byang zag med kyi bde bas rgyud gang sems rtog med chos sku dang / lus zag med bde chen rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur nas rang rang so so'i gnas dag pa'i zhing du sems can gzhan gyi don gyi phyir du bya khyu 'phur ba ltar song bar bsam/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams rang la bsdu/ de ltar mchod pa'i lha mo spro bsdu gong yi dam nas nor lha'i bar la yang gong 'og gi rigs 'gre shes par bya'o/ /spyir bla ma'i bskyed chog kun 'dus nor bu lugs su bsgom pa ni/ 'di'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsdus ba'i skabs so/ /khrom tshogs su bsgom pa ni 'dir bkod pa 'di'o/ /mtho rtsegs su bsgoms kyang chog go /maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ni tshom bu bdun ma gtso bor 'bul zhing skabs skabs su so bdun ma yang 'bul/ thun 'jog khar shes na gang gi mchod rdzas ma dang thos pa rgya mtsho ma yang bya/ 'dir sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal tshom bu lnga pa bkod ba'ang yig rnying na 'dug cing mchod pa dang 'dod don gsol gdab dang / yan lag bdun pa dang phyogs bcu dus gsum ma sogs lam 'bras ltar bya ba nyid do/ /de nas skyabs yul rnams mtha' nas rim gyis 'od du zhu ste gtso bo la thim pas skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor bsam la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bdag la dbang bskur ba bstsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ las 'od zer dkar po byung / rang gi dpral bar thim pas lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad dag bum pa'i dbang thob/ bla ma'i sku'i byin rlabs ma lus par zhugs par bsam/ mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od zer dmar po byung mgrin par thim/ ngag gi sgrib pa dag gsang ba'i dbang thob/ gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ thugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer sngon po byung snying khar thim/

sems kyi sgrib pa dag shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ yang yi ge gsum las 'od zer sna tshogs byung rang gi gnas gsum du thim/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa dag dbang bzhi pa thob par bsam/ de nas dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po che la/ phyag 'tshal lo skyabs su mchi'o/ /bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma de yang yas gtsug tor dang mas gdan khri nas rim gyis 'od du zhu nas thugs ka'i thad du 'od dmar po bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du gyur pa rdza ma tsam gcig bsam/ de yang rang gi spyi bo nas mar thim/ snying khar bde hril gyis byung nas baṃ yig la thim/ baṃ yig je cher song nas sngags phreng rnams kyang baṃ yig tu song / de nas zla ba chos 'byung / lus kyi nang gnas khang sogs nas mthar stong gsum 'jig rten gyi khams/ nam mkha'i khams thams cad kyang baṃ yig tu song ba la sems gtad nas ji tsam gnas kyi bar lhod kyis 'jog baṃ yig kyang nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar song nas dmigs med stong nyid kyi ngang la lhod de 'jog bla ma'i rnal 'byor maṇ+ḍal dang bcas pa 'di bsags sbyang sogs skabs 'ga' zhig tu zur du nyams su len na'ang skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang nas mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ges bteg pa'i sogs nas 'di'i bar nyams su blangs/ de nas thos pa rgya mtsho ma dang / skye ba kun tu sogs bya'o/ /de ltar thun mong ma yin pa'i sdon 'gro tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod pa ni/ bsod nams tshogs bsags ni 'dir bla ma'i rnal 'byor yin la de'i sbyang gzhi ni skye ba'i srid pa dang skye ba snga ma rnams su yul dag pa lha dang bla ma nas yul ma dag pa 'jag ma'i srin bu'i bar yan chad la brten nas las bzang ngan ji snyed bsags pa thams cad sbyong byed bla ma'i rnal 'byor la brten nas tshogs bsags pa'o/

/sbyangs 'bras rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob pa'o/ /sangs rgyas thob pa la sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rtogs dgos la/ de rtogs pa la yang bla ma dam pa'i man ngag dang / thabs bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa la brten dgos te/ kyai rdor rtsa rgyud las/ gzhan gyi brjod min lhan cig skyes/ /gang du yang ni mi rnyed de/ /bla ma'i dus thabs bsten pa dang / /bdag gi bsod nams las shes bya/ /zhes dang / bsdu pa las/ ji sring dge ba'i rtsa ba de ni ma rdzogs par/ /de srid stong nyid dam pa de ni rtogs mi 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /bsod nams kyi tshogs rdzogs par byed pa'i thabs kyang bla ma'i rnal 'byor las lhag pa med de/ mtshan dang dpe byad ldan ba yis/ /sku ni bskal par bsgom pa bas/ /bla ma dran pa bsod nams che'o/ /zhes pa la sogs pa mdzad/ rgyud thams cad las mthun par gsungs so/ /'o na bla ma dang sangs rgyas gnyis kyi nang nas bla ma yul lhag pa ci yin snyam na/ de gnyis spangs rtogs la khyad par med mod/ rang nyid la sangs rgyas kyi sku dngos su snang ba dang gsung dngos su thob pa'i skal ba ma byung ba la rang dang skal ba mnyam pa'i bla ma'i skur bzhengs nas chos dngos su ston par mdzad pas na/ bka' drin gyi sgo nas bla ma lhag pa yin no/ /ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma bsgoms pas byin rlabs myur zhing rnam pa sangs rgyas su bsgoms pas byin rlabs che ba ste/ so so skye bo tha mal pa'i sku lus de nyid gzhi'i rten yin pas/ de la dag bya dag byed sbyar du med pas na/ nges par rnam pa sangs rgyas su sgom par byed/ de yang lhag pa'i lha/ gang yang rung ba'i rnam par bsgom pa yod kyang 'dir bla ma'i gsung gis slob ma'i shes rgyud la phan 'dogs pa'i rten 'brel du gsung / dpa' bo rje btsun rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can du bsgom par byed pa dang / 'dir thun mong ma yin pa sangs rgyas rdo rje chos su bsgom pa ste/

lugs gnyis las/ 'dir gzhung gi dngos bstan dpa' bo rdo rje chos su bsgom pa ste/ sku mdog dmar po ni bla ma'i thugs slob ma la rjes su chags pa mtshon/ phyag g.yas pas thod pa'i ḍā ma ru rgyun mi chad par 'khrol ba'i bde stong gnyis su med pa'i chos sgra sgrog pa/ g.yon pa'i thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa/ de lta bu'i lam de nyid nyams su blangs pas bdag rgyud la bde chen gyi ye shes skye ba mtshon pa yin/ zhes gsung ngo / /de dag kyang sngar nas las bsogs pa'i tshul/ bsogs pa po'i gang zag bsags pa'i las rnams ji ltar du bsogs ba'i tshul gsum du bsgyur nas nyams su len/ ye shes kyi tshogs bsags ni/ bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la bstims pa'i rkyen gyis lus sems rnams bde chen gyi ye shes su byin gyis rlabs shing gnas lugs de kho na nyid la blo bzhag pa'o/ /de'i sbyang gzhi bdag gzhan gyi 'chi srid do/ /sbyangs 'bras chos sku thob pa'o/ /de ltar thun mong gi sngon 'gro skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro bla ma'i rnal 'byor maṇ+ḍal 'bul zhing gsol ba btab pa rnams rtags ma byung bar du 'bad nas nyams su blang bar bya zhing / de la rtags ni/ skyabs 'gro rgyud la skyes na blo chos su 'gro zhing / blo sna dkon mchog gi 'phrog nas srog dang bya dga'i phyir yang dkon mchog blos mi gtong ba sogs dang / sems bskyed rgyud la skyes na/ sems can thams cad la bcos min gyi byams snying rje sran mi bzod pa skye ba sogs dang / rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas la 'bad pas/ sdig pa dag pa'i rtags rmi lam du lus las rnag khrag 'dzag pa dang / 'bu srin 'thon pa dang / khrus byas pa dang / 'phur ba dang / gyen la 'dzegs pa rnams byung na legs shing / gzhan gyis mtshon cha bsnun nas khrag byung ba dang / rab byung gi rten la skra ring dang /

gos dkar po gyon pa dang / zhing rmo ba'i thong mkhan byed pa dang / gnyan pa byed pa rnams ngan ngan 'dra yang bzang ba yin/ rol mo'i sgra bsgrag ba dang / gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan 'phyar ba rnams grags pa che ba'i rtags/ zhwa theb dkar dmar sngo ser gsar pa gyon pa dang / chos 'chad pa dang / mang pos bskur ba dang / gdan khri'i mthon po'i steng du 'dzegs pa rnams gzhan don 'byung ba'i rtags la sogs pa'o/ /maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba'i bsod nams kyi tshogs 'phel ba'i rtags/ khri stan mthon po la 'dug pa dang / gzhan gyi rdzas stobs chen 'bul ba rmi ba sogs dang / bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes bcos min skye ba sogs mdor na lus sems las su rung ba'i shin sbyangs dang / ldan pa zhig ma byung gi bar du sngon 'gro'i chos rnams la 'bad par bya ste 'di rnams rgyud la ma skyes na dngos gzhi'i ting nge 'dzin mi skye bas so/ /drug pa bdag lhar bskyed pa ni/ gzhung las de'i rjes la snying khar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam la/ der oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhāḥ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyi 'phreng ba kha dog dmar po de las 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba lugs las bzlog par bsam mo/ /dbus su baṃ yig go /de'i 'od zer gyi lus thams cad khyab pas yongs su dag pa nas/ zhes gsungs la/ sa skya pa chen pos/ rang gi snying khar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la baṃ yig dmar po de'i mtha' mar sngags kyi phreng ba kha dog dmar po g.yon bskor du bkod la/ de las 'od zer byung ba'i lus kyi nang thams cad 'od kyi gang ste des lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib thams cad dag pas lus shel sgong dag pa bzhin du gyur pa la/ rje btsun ma'i sku gzhung nas 'byung ba bzhin bskyed la gsal gdab bo/ /zhes gsungs pas/ gzhi sbyangs zhing bsgyur bar bya ste/ de la sbyong rgyu'i gzhi ni rang gi sems nyid gnyis su med pa'i ye shes chos sku skye med zung 'jug brjod bral de kho na nyid chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs su gyur ba'i spros bral stong pa nyid 'di'i steng na phung khams skye mched la sogs pa 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad sems la bag chags kyis tshang lus la rtsa yi ge'i tshul du dod/
