de'i stobs kyi phyi rol du gnas snod kyi 'jig rten/ bcud kyis sems can bsam gyis mi khyab pa gcig 'char ba yin te/ de'ang 'od gsal de bag chags kyis bslad pa la rten nas/ ma rig par langs nas/ nyon mongs pa gti mug de las 'dod chags/ de las zhe sdang / de las nga rgyal dang ser sna langs te bar do'i snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa gcig 'char la/ de nas gang du skye ba len pa'i gnas bzhi/ skye ba blangs pa'i gnas kyi 'jig rten/ skye ba blangs pa'i bcud kyi sems can la'ang dmyal ba la sogs pa'i 'gro ba rigs drug rigs drug po de'i lus sems la bde ldug 'dod mi 'dod bsam gyis mi khyab pa gcig shar ba rnams nang gi rten dkyil 'khor bzhi'i stobs kyis shar ba yin te/ phyi rol tu gzugs sdug mi sdug ji snyed yod pa rnams nang rtsa'i stobs kyis shar cing / phyi ru sgra snyan mi snyan gyis bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams nang gi yi ge'i stobs kyis shar la/ phyi rol du tshor ba bde sdug btang snyoms la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams nang bdud rtsi'i stobs kyis shar ba yin la/ phyi rol du rnam rtog bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams nang rlung gis stobs kyis shar ba yin te/ ye shes thig le las/ stong pa las ni thams cad 'byung / /zhes dang / sdom 'byung las/ rnam pa sna tshogs dri med pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor dag ni 'phro bar snang / /zhes gsungs/ des na phyi rol tu shar tshad nang na gnas/ nang na gnas tshad phyi rol tu shar ba yin te/ ye shes thig le las/ phyi dang phyi'i don rnams kyis/ /nang gi don gnas shes par bya'o/ /zhes dang / bde mchog rtsa rgyud las/ 'jig rten phyi rol de bzhin nang / /zhes pa dang / kyai rdor rtsa rgyud las/ ji ltar phyi rol de bzhin nang / /zhes gsungs so/ /des na phyi rol du snang tshad nang gi rten dkyil 'khor bzhi la tshang ba yin no/ /de'ang dang por rtsa dbu ma/

de las ro rkyang gnyis/ de las sbas pa'i rtsa lnga/ de las nyi shu rtsa lnga/ de las sum cu rtsa bdun/ de las bsam gyis mi khyab ba gyes pa rnams dang / bdud rtsi yang dang por dwangs ma/ de las khu khrag gnyis/ de las khas bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams dang / rlung yang dang por gnas pa/ de las ldang 'jug gnyis/ de las rtsa'i rlung lnga/ de las rlung bcu/ de las nyi khri gcig stong bsam gyis mi khyab pas so/ /rten dkyil 'khor bzhi po de'i stobs kyis phyi rol/ snod bcud kyis snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas pa thams cad sems nyid kyis rnam 'phrul yin pas de dag blo'i yul du nges par bya ba ni rgya che ba'i sbyangs gzhi yin la/ nang rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga ni zab pa'i sbyangs gzhi/ sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa ni mthar thug gi sbyangs gzhi yin la/ sbyong byed ni lha rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dbye na rang sems spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba ni gsang ba'i rnal 'byor ma/ lte ba'i rtsa mdud gru gsum gyi nang ma las thob pa'i dwangs ma gnyis mdang gsum mdang kyi dwangs mas khrig mer te gang ba'i a thung shad kyi rnam pa can chos 'di pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i baṃ yig gi rnam pa can nang gi rnal 'byor ma phyi rol 'og min na bzhugs pa'i rje btsun ma ni lhan skyes kyi rnal 'byor ma/ yul nyer bzhi dang gnas sum cu rtsa bdun na bzhugs pa'i sprul pa'i dpa' bo dang dpa' mo rnams zhing las skyes ba'i rnal 'byor ma/ ma mkha' 'gro ma yin pa'i rigs su skyes pa rnams ni las las skyes pa/ yul dang yul gru thams cad na gnas pa'i bud med thams cad ni las las skyes pa'i rnal 'byor ma/ rang nyid rnal 'byor mar bsgom pa ni sngags las skyes pa'i rnal 'byor ma'o/ /de ltar na rang gi sems nyid ye gdod ma nas rdo rje rnal 'byor mar yin pa de bla mas byin gyi rlabs ba'i dus yin par ngo sprad rang nyid kyis kyang yin par ngo shes nas/

de'i rgyun skyongs pa bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len byas pas/ phyi rol gyi dpa' bo dang dpa' mo rnams dbang du 'dus/ de rnams dbang du 'dus pas 'og min gyi rdo rje rnal 'byor mas byin gyis rlabs/ des byin gyis rlabs pas rang sems lhan skyes kyi rtogs pa 'char bas de ni byin gyis rlobs pas slob pa dang / rtogs pa las 'char zhes pa'i don to/ /tshul ji ltar sbyong na blo yul du nges pa'i sbyang gzhi de dag bla ma 'od du zhu ba'i rkyen gyis bde chen gyi ye shes su bsgyur/ mngon par byang chub pa lnga ni/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor mar bsgom pa'i snying khar chos 'byung nyis brtsegs stong par bsgom pa ni stong pa nyid las byang chub pa/ de'i dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom pa ni gdan zla ba la byang chub pa/ de'i steng du baṃ yig sngags phreng dang bcas ba bsgom pa ni gsung yig 'bru las byang chub pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas tshe thog med nas bsags ba'i sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs lus 'od kyi gong bu gri gug gi dbyibs su gyur ba ni thugs phyag mtshan las byang chub pa/ de nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku gyur ba ni/ sku rdzogs pa las byang chub pa ste/ mngon par byang chub pa lnga las bskyed ba'o// stong nyid de'i ngang nas rang rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i snying khar gnas lugs rtogs pa'i shes rab mtshon pas e byu ru'i mdog can nyis brtsegs yongs su gyur pa las/ chos sku rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum gyi rang bzhin/ chos 'byung nyis brtsegs te/ bka' brgyud pa sogs chos 'byung phyi ma gdan stabs/ de'i steng du chos 'byung nang ma langs thams su bsgom par 'dod kyang rang lugs chos 'byung phyi ma de dwangs gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin can rnyog pa med par bsam/ rtse mo mdun la bstan pa/ zur gnyis ldebs la bstan pa/

rtsa ba phra ba gsang gnas su zug la/ gdeng ka che ba gyen du bstan pa/ chos 'byung nang ma zur gsum phyi la bstan/ zhes mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ gsung la/ dpe la lar/ chos 'byung nyis brtsegs phyi ma'i zur sgal tshigs la bstan pa zur gnyis po nu ma gnyis kyi thad du bstan pa/ nang ma'i zur mdun la bstan pa/ zur gnyis sog pa gnyis kyi thad du bstan/ de gnyis ka'i mas sna gsang gnas su zug pa/ zhes 'byung bas gang dag dpyod/ 'dir chos 'byung phyi mas snod kyi 'jig rten sbyong / nang mas ma'i mngal sbyong gsung / chos 'byung nang ma'i kha 'tshams 'phel kha che ba'i thad du mnyam bzhag gi rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin de rjes thob dag pa 'jig rten pa'i ye shes mtshon pa'i phyir zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dkar bsil nya gang ba de'i dbus su baṃ yig gi mthar g.yon skor du sngags kha dog dmar po gyen du langs pa/ de yang baṃ yig gi mdun du/ oṃ oṃ oṃ/ de'i 'khris su sarba log pas rbas/ de'i khris su bud+dha log pas d+dhabu/ de'i khris su ki ḍā/ de'i khris su ye nī/ de'i khris su dz+rab/ de'i khris su r+ṇawa/ de'i khris su ye nī/ de'i khris su dz+rab/ de'i khris su ro bai/ de'i khris su ye ne tsa/ de'i khris su hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ dang / ṭapha ṭapha ṭapha/ de'i khris su hā swā/ oṃ dang po'i rtsa bar sleb pa chos 'byung gi mdun rgyab spangs pa'i grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil ba kha dog dkar po g.yon du 'khor ba re re bsam/ 'di ni sbyang gzhi bar do'i srid pa sbyong bar byed ba yin no/ /'dir zla ba la dmar mdangs yod pa/ nyi zlas khu khrag yig 'bru rnams kyis bar do'i sems/ thams cad sdom pas mngal skyes sbyong / nyi zlas drod gsher skyes de thams cad gcig tu 'dres pas sgong skyes/ de rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gyur pas brdzus skyes sbyong / sbyong byed de dag thams cad 'byung bzhi rang gi sems nyid mtshon ba'i phyir rang gi sems sam/

sdud byed kyi gtso bo las rnal 'byor ma so bdun 'byung ba mtshon pa'i phyir de'i mthar yi ge so bdun g.yon skor du bskor ba/ 'o na rgyu dang rgya gzhung du oṃ gcig las ma bshad pas 'dir gsum 'byung ba ji lta yin snyam na/ mi dbang chos gsum du grags pa'i mi'i dbang po in+d+ra bo dhis bshad pa/ rje btsun gyi shes byed du mdzad de gang du rdo rje phag mo'i rtsa ba'i las ma tshang ba rnams 'dis kha bskang bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs/ zhal gnyis ma phag mo thams cad kyi rtsa ba phag zhal yod/ gzhan phag mo'i rigs las byung ba la phag mor bzhag go/ de dag kyang rten dkyil 'khor bzhi la gnad du bsnun pa yin te/ rtsa bsam gyis mi khyab pa chos 'byung du bsdu/ yi ge bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams yig 'brur bsdu/ khams bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ rlung bsam gyis mi khyab rnams dga' ba 'khyil par bsdu/ 'dus pa pho brang bzhi ma'ang gnad du bsnun pa yi ge gong du brjod zin to/ /dper na gzhi sbyang ba'i gzhi de dag nges par byas nas/ bsgyur ba'i tshul ni zla ba baṃ yig yig 'bru dang bcas pa rnams las 'od zer kha dog sna lnga 'ja' tshon lta bu bun gyis 'phros/ 'khor 'das thams cad tshang ba'i rang gi lus sems la phog pas tshe thog ma med pa na bsags pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib nyes ltung bag chags dang bcas pa dang rnam smin gdos bcas sha khrag gis bsdus pa'i phung khams skye mched thams cad bsregs sbyangs pas rang gi lus shel sgong dag pa ltar 'od kyi gong bur gyur par bsgom pa ni gzhi sbyang ba'o/ /de nas bsgyur ba ni/ gzhung las/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo'i sku zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma sku mdog dmar mo bskal pa'i me lta bu gzi brjid can/ phyag rgya lnga yis rgyan dang ldan pa/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la 'jigs byed dus mtshan mnan pa/

phyag g.yas na rdo rje dang gri gug g.yon na thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'o/ /de yang 'od kyi gong bu de las skad cig gis rten dang brten par bcas pa wal gyis bskyed nas gsal btab cing dag bya dag byed ngo sprod pa ni ma dag pa snod kyi 'jig rten/ dag pa mtshon byed chos 'byung nyis brtsegs bsgom pa dngos su med kyang bsgom don la ma chad pa gal che'o/ /zhes mus chen bud+dha'i mtshan can gyi gsungs pa'o/ /spro na de'i phyi rol du yang rdo rje'i sa gzhi dur khrod brgyad/ de'i phyi rol rdo rje'i gur dang bcas pa bde kye dang mthun la/ de'i phyi rol rwa ba gru bzhi pa 'greng bur gyur pa/ gur las dpangs cung zad dma' ba/ de'i kha khyer gyi mdun rgyab 'thab ra lta bus bskor ba'i nang du sgo 'tshams ma brgyad shar gyi g.yas su steng gi khro mo/ nub kyi g.yon du 'og gi khro mo rnams gsal btab/ de'i phyi rol du me'i 'obs gru bzhi pa cha chen gcig dpangs cha chen phyed 'tshub cing tsha ba/ de'i steng gi bar snang la mda'i drwa ba mda'i mde'u rtse dang stong rnams bsrel ba mde'u rtse phyir bstan pa gur gyi dpangs dang mnyam pa/ de dang 'obs kyi phyi rol du ye shes kyi me kha dog lnga g.yon bskor du 'bar ba me'i rtse mo shin tu mtho ba rab tu tsha bar bsam/ kha khyer gyi sgo 'tshams ma rnams las de 'dra ba dpag med spros/ gnod byed thams cad bkug 'obs kyi phyir mthar bkod/ slar yang khro mo de rnams las stod khro bo bcu'i rnam pa smad phur bu'i rnam pa can dpag med spros gnod byed rnams kyi spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar bkas pho g.yon mo g.yas yin/ de ltar byas pas thams cad kyi rnam shes chos dbyings su bsgral sha rus rnams 'obs nang du 'phangs khro bo rnams rang la thim/ chos 'byung gi nang du sna tshogs pad+ma yu ba khru gang ba steng 'og gi pad 'dab bcu drug

ze 'bru la cha chen gcig 'dab ma rnams la cha chen phyed phyed 'og gi 'dab ma rnams thur du 'phyangs nas yu ba la bkab pa'i tshul du yod par bsam/ zhes zin bris las 'byung ngo / /'di nyid lam bsdus pa'i skabs yin pas bsrung 'khor 'di nyid med kyang 'gal ba cher med la/ 'di ltar byung na shin tu legs la srung 'khor gzhal yas khang med pa'i lha dpa' bo gcig pa la snod kyi 'jig rten sbyong byed gdan yin par mngon rtogs ljon shing las gsungs so/ /'dir ni spros pa la dga' zhing rgyas pa'i dbang du byas so/ /gang ltar yang rgya gzhung gi phag mo'i sgrub thabs 'gar yang bsrung 'khor chos 'byung sogs snang ngo / /bsdus pa ltar na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la bde mchog gi rten dang brten pa tshang ste rgyas par 'og tu 'chad do/ /mtshon don nam dag bya dag byed ngo sprad pa ni/ pad+ma 'dam las skyes kyang 'dam gyi dri mas ma gos pa zhes 'byung ba ltar/ sgrub pa po 'khor bar gnas kyang 'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos pa'i brdar sna tshogs/ de'ang sangs rgyas sems can gyi bcud las skyes kyang nyon mongs pa'i dri mas ma gos pa zhes bya ba ltar ro/ /pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru'i steng du rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba mtshon pa dang / byang chub kyi sems kyi myu gu 'phel zhing smin pa'i rtags su nyi ma yang na thabs snying rje mtshon pas pad+ma/ gnas lung rtogs pa'i shes rab mtshon pas nyi ma'o/ /de'i steng du 'jigs byed nag po g.yas ḍā ma ru dang gri gug g.yon thod ba dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bzung ba mgo bo g.yon phyogs su bstan pa zhi sdang dang phrag dog skye ba'am/ gzung 'dzin bskyed byed kyi gnas yin pas/ mgo bo snying kha'i thad du rgyab du bstan nas dpral ba nas ji ltar mnan pa/ de yang snying kha zhe sdang skye ba'i gnas dang / dpral ba phrag dog skye ba'i gnas yin pas de nyid zhabs g.yon pas mnan pa'o/ /zhabs g.yas pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo gri gug dang /

thod ba gzung ba 'dod chags skye ba'i gnas nu ma'i steng nas mnan pa mgo bo g.yas su bstan pa'o/ /de yang nges brjod las/ 'jigs byed dang ni dus mtshan dag /chags pa zhe sdang zhabs kyis mnan/ /zhes gsungs/ de yang ji ltar zhe na/ zhabs g.yon 'dod chags rnam par dag pas zhe sdang gi ngo bo 'jigs byed dang / g.yas pa zhe sdang rnam par dag pas 'dod chags kyi ngo bo dus mtshan mnan pa'o/ /'di gnyis ma shi ba yin pa jo bo rjes bshad gsung ngo / /des na dbang phyug la sogs pa 'jig rten pa'i chen po rnams 'dul ba mtshon pa'o/ /de gnyis kyi steng du rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje chen pos sems can la rjes su chags pa mtshon pa'i brdar sku mdog pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar zhing / gdug pa can tshar gcod pas ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas 'od zer dmar po 'phro zhing bskal pa'i me lta bur drag cing gzi brjid 'bar ba ste a bhi dha na las/ de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /phag mo yin ni sgrub pa mchog /bsgom pa'i bdag nyid bsgom bar bya/ /sku ni nyi ma brgya'i gzi/ /sku mdog gzi brjid dang mtshungs pa/ /me tog ban+tu ka lta bu/ /zhes gsungs/ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib g.yogs dang bral ba mtshon pas sku gcer bu/ chos thams cad de bzhin nyid du ro gcig pa'i brdar zhal gcig /bden pa gnyis thugs su chud pa'i brdar phyag gnyis ma/ nga rgyal la sogs pa'i 'khor ba'i skyon thams cad gcod pa'i brdar phyag g.yas pas rdo rje gri gug ni/ spyir rdo rje zhes bya ba tsam gyi dbang du byas na/ chos nyid kyi rdo rje/ mtshan ma'i rdo rje thabs sam/ gsang ba'i rdo rje/ rdzas kyi rdo rje ste bzhi'o/ /dang po ni/ mtshan rtog 'joms pa'i ye shes stong nyid rdo rje ste gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi snying po'o/ /rdo rje'i mtshan don de ltar yin/ 'dir ni de lta bus rdo rje phyed pas yu ba byas pa'i gri gug sor brgyad dam bcu gnyis pa gugs ba'i phyogs su rtse mo cung zad gug pa rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug thur du bskyangs nas mgo 'khor ba'i phyogs la 'jol thabs su bsnams pa ni bdag tu 'dzin pa'i dgra bo rang gis gcod cing gzhan gcod pa mtshon/

de yang gzhung las/ rdo rje dang gri gug ces gsungs kyang / phyag len la ye shes lnga mtshon pa'i brdar rdo rje rtse lnga pa phyed pas mtshan pa'i gri gug mdzad do/ /bde chen gyi ye shes mkha' spyod kyi go 'phangs mnyes pa'i brdar g.yon pas zla ba ltar dkar ba'i thod pa bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin khrag gis gang ba steng gi phyogs su bzung ste zhal gyen du phyogs pas rgyun mi chad par gsol ba/ rang nyid shes rab ma yin pa'i brdar zhal g.yon du phyogs pa/ thabs he ru ka dang mi 'bral ba'i brdar phrag pa g.yon bar kha ṭ+wāṃ ka ni/ kha zhes bya nam mkha' yin la/ ṭ+wāṃ ka zhes pa keng rus sam dbyug rdo ste nam mkha'i dbyug pa zhes pa gzhi lam 'bras bu'i chos thams cad mtshon pas lus tshad dang mnyam pa mdor na 'khor lo bde mchog gi gsang ba gsum gyi zab gnad thams cad mtshon pas yu ba dkar po brgyad zhogs su byas pas 'phags lam brgyad mtshon/ rtsa ba la rdo rje rtse lnga pa phyed pas mtshan pa 'gro ba rgyud lnga mtshon/ gyen du 'phel kha che ba ni yon tan gong nas gong du 'phel ba mtshon/ des 'gro ba rgyud lnga sku gsum gyi sar 'dren pa mtshon no/ de yang sangs rgyas su 'gro ba'i lam lnga ni tshogs sbyor sogs yin zhing / 'dir sems can du 'khrul ba'i lam rgyud lnga ste/ rmi lam gyi lam dang / bag chags kyi lam dang / las kyi mtha'i lam dang / 'khrul 'khor ma nges pa'i lam dang / rgyu dang 'bras bus so sor ma nges ba'i lam dang lnga nas so/ yang lam rgyud lnga ni/ ngan song gsum/ lha mi zung gcig ste/ rgya rol las/ srid sred ma rig dbang gis skye bo rnams/ /mi dang lha gnas ngan song rnam gsum po/ /'gro ba lnga po dag du mi mkhas 'khor/ /zhes gsung so/ /rtse mor sna tshogs rdo rje'i khar bum pa de'i khar thod pa skam rlon 'dres ma gsum mang na skam po gsum brtsegs pa'i khar rdo rje rtse lnga pa drangs pos mtshan pa/

thabs snying rje chen po dang / gnas lugs rtogs pa'i shes rab zung du chud pa la brten nas sems can gyi don 'bad med bsgrub ba mtshon/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ka la ḍā ma ru dang dril bu dang 'phan rtse gsum pa 'phyangs bzhin pa dang rtsa ba mdun la bstan pa/ rtse mo rgyab la bstan pa phrag pa la bkal ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin pa'am gru mor 'dzin par yang mus chen gyi bshad/ yang kha ṭ+wāṃ kas lha sku/ ḍā ma ru dang g.yer khas gsung / 'phan rtse gsum pas thugs rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum mtshon pas yab kyi sku gsung thugs mtshon/ las kyi rdo rje phyed pa'i bsrung 'khor rkang gi brgyad zhogs dur khrod brgyad/ sna tshogs rdo rje gzhal yas khang / thod pa skam rlon snying gsum ni sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lo/ bum pa ni bde chen 'khor lo/ steng gi rdo rje phyed pa ni tog yin no/ /rten dkyil 'khor du ma zad brten pa lha yang tshang ste/ steng gi rdo rje phyed pa bcom ldan 'das yum ni rje btsun ma nyid dngos su snang ba/ bum pas snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi bum thod dang bcas pa/ mi mgo gsum gyis thugs gsung sku'i dpa' bo dang dpa' mo bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad/ sna tshogs rdo rje ni dam tshig 'khor lo'i rnal 'byor ma brgyad yin no/ /yang sna tshogs rdo rjes 'phrin las sna tshogs pa'i sems can gyi don byed pas sprul sku mtshon/ bum pa ni bde ba chen po ste longs sku mtshon/ thod pa skam po gsum ni rnam thar sgo gsum rang bzhin chos sku mtshon/ steng gi rdo rje rtse lnga pa ni sku gsum po re re yang ye shes lnga lnga'i bdag nyid can yin no/ /de dag ni thugs kyi gsang ba mtshon la/ ḍā ma ru dang dril bus ni gsung gis gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / 'phan gyis ni sku'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa mtshon gsung / bshad pa gzhan yang / kha ṭ+wāṃ ka rang gi lus tshad dang mnyam pa chos thams cad rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag cing /

kha dog gang du'ang bsgyur du rung ba'i brdar dkar po'o/ /'khor ba'i rtsa ba phra ba'i brdar rtsa ba phra ba'o/ /yang sna tshogs rdo rjes bum dbang / bum pas gsang dbang / thod skam gsum gyis shes dbang / steng gi rdo rje rtse lnga pas dbang bzhi pa mtshon no/ /'dir rgyas par bshad na mtha' yas mod/ don hril gyis bsdu na mchog tu mi 'gyur ba bde ba chen po'i brda ste nang du rig stong zung 'jug go /gzigs par bya ba'i gnas khams gsum la gzigs shing / mkhyen par bya ba dus gsum cig car du mkhyen pa mnyes par bya ba sku gsum gyi go 'phang mnyes pa mtshon pas spyan gsum ma/ bdag 'dzin grol bar mtshon pas dbu skra nag po ma 'dzings shing ma mdud pa sil bur gyur pa/ sku sked yan chad khebs pa ste kun 'dzin gyi rtog pa'i mdud pa thams cad grol ba'i brda' 'o/ /nyon mongs pa lnga spangs ye shes lnga mtshon pa'i brdar ltag par gnyer ma gsum mgul pa gnyis su gnyer ma re re yod pa ye shes lnga'am/ rgyal ba rigs lnga mtshon pas mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan/ de re re yang ye shes lnga lnga mtshon pas leb mo sor lnga pa rgya tshos kyis kha mig bzos pa re re'i steng du gser la sogs pa rin po che'i rtse phran gyis dbus su rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan dang bcas pa rin po che'i 'khyud mo'am rus pa'i 'khyud mos steng 'og gnyis na gsum gshibs re res bar na gnyis gshibs dang bcas pas brgyan pa/ thod skam 'di'i tshad la rje ngag dbang chos grags kyis 'khrid yig du sor bcu gnyis pa zhes 'byung bas mtheb sor lnga la mdzub mo'i rtse sor nyi shu byas pa'i bcu gnyis sam/ yang na mthe'u chung gi bcu gnyis te mtshon don rten 'brel bcu gnyis so zhes gsungs te da dung dpyad do/ /nang gi khams ā li kā li lnga bcu dag pa'i brdar mi mgo skam po lnga bcu/ ye shes kyi snang ba las grub pa'i ro skra'i thag pa las brgyus pa'i do shal phrag pa nas brla'i bar du 'phyang ba/

yum la thod skam lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa'i don ni yum shes rab byang sems dmar po'i rang bzhin yin pa la/ thod skam gyis byang sems dkar po mtshan pas brgyan pa'o/ /thabs dang mi 'bral ba mtshon pas thal ba dang mchod phyir thogs shes rab mtshon byed yin la/ des na rang nyid stong nyid kyi ngo bo yin pa'i phyir de gnyis spangs pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ de dag kyang spyi bor rtsa 'dab sor gnyis mtshon pa'i brdar rus pa'i 'khor lo drwa mig sum cu so gnyis pa/ skra thams cad drwa mig nang nas yar drangs pa/ de'i mthar thod skam gyi mdun du drwa ba drwa phyed sor gnyis tsam dang sna ltag gnyis rnams su cung zad 'phyang ba'i mtha' rnams su dril chung dang bcas pa ste spyi bor 'khor 'das bsam gtan mtshon/ snyan gnyis la rus ba'i a long gnyis brtsegs rus thung dang bcas pa mtha' rnams su nor bu mig gsum pa re res brgyan pa des bzod pa mtshon/ nang gi rtsa 'dab bcu drug mtshon pa'i brdar mgul rgyan rus ba'i gzhung gsum dra mig bcu drug dril chung sogs gong dang 'dra/ des sbyin pa mtshon/ yan lag rnams la rus pa'i gzhung gsum gsum drwa ba drwa phyed dril chung dang bcas pa/ dpung rgyan dang lag gdub gnyis drwa phyed kha sprod/ zhabs kyi drwa phyed dril chung rnams thur du 'phyang ba de dag gi tshul khrims mtshon/ lte bar nang gi rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi mtshon pa'i brdar 'og lpags sam smad rgyan nam ske rags zhes bya ba'i rus pa'i gzhung gsum bar na nyis gshibs kyi sdom pa drwa mig drug cu rtsa bzhi drwa phyed dril chung ring ba rnams bol gong / de las thung ba rnams pus mo dang / de las thung ba rnams spyi mgor slebs pa'o/ /des brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mtshon te/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud las/ pha rol phyin drug rgyan drug sogs/ sems dpa' chen po'i dngos slob/

blo gros rin chen pa'i kyai rdor mngon rtogs bshad par/ rgyan drug ni/ lus mtha' dag la thal chen gyi rgya'am/ mchod phyir thogs kyi snying kha'i thad du pad+ma 'dab brgyad byas pa ni/ snying kha'i rtsa 'dab brgyad mtshon/ des sam/ tshangs skud dam/ de gsum/ gang rung gis kyang rgyan drug gis go ni chod do/ /yum la ni rgyan drug pa mi dgos te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir/ zhes so/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rang shes rab kyi ngo bo yin pas se ral kha dang thal chen gyi rgya mi dgos gsung / de'i spyi gtsug tu rang chas rigs bdag rnam snang he ru ka dkar po phyag gnyis kyi 'khor lo dang dril bu thugs khar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang / g.yas brgyad g.yon bskum du'ang bshad 'dug pas legs pa 'dra'o/ /rgyan la rus pa dang rin po che gnyis ka bshad 'dug pas dpyad do/ /ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa legs par gsal btab bo/ /de'ang rigs bdag rang chas dang / dbang bskur nas rgyas 'debs pa gnyis te/ sbyang gzhi la rgyal po'i bu lta bu rgyal srid du dbang ma bskur ba mchod yul du mi 'gyur ba zhig dang / skyes tsam nyid nas rang gi gzhi sogs la dbang bas rigs te lugs gnyis 'byung ba'i phyi ma dang bstun nas rang chas su sgom pa ste/ ngag 'don la med pa rnams su bsam bya la/ de lta bu'i rigs bdag ni ma chad pa shin tu gal che ste/ ches rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ bskyed pa'i rim pa'i mthar thug la/ /dbu rgyan la ni rigs bdag 'byung / /rigs bdag de ni bla ma yin/ /'di ni gal te 'chol gyur na/ /dngos grub med par rgyud las gsum/ /zhes gsungs pas rang gi rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs thob pa'i bla ma de nyid dang gzhan yang chos 'brel thob pa'i bla ma thams cad dang ngo bo dbyer med du shes dgos so/ /phyi nang gi gdon bgegs thams cad bsregs par mtshon pas rang gi sku las skyes pa'i ye shes me dpung chen po'i dbus na bzhugs pa/

bdud bzhi skrag par byed pa'i brdar mche ba bzhi brtsig pa/ bde chen gyi ye shes rgyas pa'i brdar nu 'bur gnyis dam shing rgyas pa/ dga' ba bcu drug rgyas pa'i brdar gzhon nu lo bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/ thabs dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje chen pos sems can thams cad rjes su 'dzin pa'i brdar zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas myang 'das kyi mtha' dus mtshan ma mnan pa/ gnas lugs rtogs pa'i shes rab chen pos 'khor ba'i phyogs su ma lhung pa'i brdar zhabs g.yon bskums pas 'khor ba'i mtha' 'jigs byed mnan pa'o/ /'di gnyis gnon tshul rgyas par gdan gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar ro/ /mtha' gnyis spangs nas mi gnas pa'i myang 'das su bsgrub pa'o/ /de ltar rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku 'od dang 'od zer gyi rang bzhin can du bsgom mo/ /'di dag ni skye srid sbyong byed yin la/ 'khor lo bde mchog gi zab gnad bdag gzhan gyi gzhi sbyang sgyur zhes bya ba'i bdag gi gzhi sbyang sgyur gnyis tshang ba yin te/ sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros nas sdig sgrib rnam smin gyi phung po dang bcas pa stong nyid du sbyangs pa ni bdag gi gzhi sbyangs pa dang / de'i ngang las/ rang nyid rje btsun ma'i sku zhal phyag rgyan cha lugs yongs rdzogs dang ldan par bskyed pa ni bdag gi zhing bsgyur ba yin no/ /rje mus pa'i rnam bshad du skabs 'dir lus dkyil bsgom pa 'byung yang tshar chen dang / mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyi 'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor gyi rjes su 'byung bas der brjod par bya'o/ /mkhyen brtse dbang pos ni ye shes pa bcug pa'i rkyen gyis lus dkyil gsal 'debs par gsungs so/ /bdun pa 'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ gzhung las/ yang yang de las 'od 'phros pas 'gro ba thams cad dag par byas te/ slar log ste sngags kyi 'phreng ba de nyid la zhugs pa dang / zhes gsungs/ sa skya pa chen pos/

sngags phreng las 'od zer byung ste ba spu'i bu ga nas song / rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la phog pas de thams cad kyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig pa dag par bsam zhing rje btsun ma'i skur bskyed do/ /zhes gsungs pas/ snying kha'i sngags phreng las 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs 'phros lus kyi nang thams cad gang / ba spu'i bu ga nas phar song / snod bcud thams cad la phog pas sdig sgrib thams cad dag snod chos 'byung dang bcud kyi sems can thams cad rnal 'byor ma'i skur bsgoms te/ de yang 'od zer de rigs drug bar do dang bcas pa'i sems can thams cad la phog ma thag sdig sgrib rnam smin gyi phung po dang bcas pa skad cig nyid la sbyangs/ thams cad rnal 'byor ma'i sku rgyan cha lugs zhal phyag yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ 'di la gzhan gyi zhing sbyang bsgyur gnyis tshang ba yin te/ phyi nang snod bcud thams cad rang sems kho na'i yin pa'i don gyi sbyangs pa dang bsgyur du btub pa yin gyi rang las tha dad du bsgrub pa zhig yin na de dag sbyang bsgyur mi nus gsung / de dag kyang mngon brjod las/ ba spu'i bu ga'i rtsa las spro/ /chos kyi 'khor lo ltos par byed/ /'gro ba rigs drug bsgral nas ni/ /bla med byang chub la bzhag bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'gro ba rdo rje rnal 'byor mar byas pa 'di rnams skabs 'di nyid du rang la bsdu ba'am/ 'og ye shes pa bstim pa dang mnyam du bsdu ba gang mos bya'o/ /'dir lus dkyil gyi lha gsal btab pa ni/ spyir phyi dkyil las lus dkyil khyad par 'phags pa'i rgyu mtshan bde kye gnyis kyi zab mo lus dkyil gyi skabs su rtogs par bya'o/ /'di la'ang zhal gnyis ma'i rdzogs rim sngags kyi de nyid grub par gsungs pa 'di bla ma'i thun mong ba zhig dang / thun mong ma yin pa grub chen nā ro pa'i slob bshad/ snyan brgyud kho nar bzhugs pa ste lugs gnyis las 'dir phyi ma ste/

rang rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i snying khar lus dkyil bsgom pa ni/ mngon brjod las/ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i snying khar ni/ /sku gsung thugs dang bcas par bsgom/ /zhes gsungs pas/ chos 'byung dang zla ba ni sku'i ngo bo/ baṃ yig ni thugs kyi ngo bo/ yig 'bru rnams ni gsung gi ngo bo'o/ /rnal 'byor ma sum cu rtsa bdun gyi ngo bo yin te/ mngon brjod las/ bcom ldan bdag pos 'di gsungs te/ /yi ge re re rnal 'byor ma/ /de nas rnal 'byor ma mchod bya/ /rnal 'byor ma ni sngags kyi sku/ /de tshe dngos grub 'dod pa yis/ /de dag dbye ba mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ yi ge so gnyis rnal 'byor ma so gnyis/ baṃ yig cha lnga rnal 'byor lnga'o/ /de yang klad skor rdo rje phag mo yin pas so/ /lha drug cu rtsa gnyis tshang tshul dang sbyar na/ chos 'byung gi gzhal yas khang mtshon/ zla bas dpa' bo nyer bzhi mtshon/ yig 'bru bai ro tsa nī yan gyi dpa' bo nyer bzhi mtshon/ de ltar zla ba yig 'bru rnams thabs shes rab sbyor bas oṃ dang po khaṇ+ḍa ka pa la dang rab tu gtum mo zhes sogs sbyar ro/ /de ltar na sku'i rnam pa'ang dpa' bo dpa' mo zhal sbyor gyi rnam par bsgom mam snyam na/ de ni mi dgos te/ 'di rnal 'byor ma so bdun kha ṭ+wāṃ ka dang bcas pa rnams la yab yum gyi mtshon don tshang ba'i phyir/ 'di man brgyad kyi sgo mtshams ma brgyad mtshon/ baṃ yig gi srog yig ya ra la wa bzhis snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi mtshon/ a thung ngam baṃ yig gis gtso bo yab yum mtshon/ de rnams rang gnas su lus dkyil bsgom pa ni/ yi ge nyer bzhi'i dpal mo nyer bzhi/ de rnams kyi kha ṭ+wāṃ ka nyer bzhis dpa' bo nyer bzhi mtshon/ yi ge lhag ma brgyad kyi sgo mtshams ma brgyad/ de brgyad kyi kha ṭ+wāṃ kas gtso bo'i phyag tha ma brgyad mtshon/ srog yig bzhi'i ngo bo rnal 'byor ma bzhi'i kha ṭ+wāṃ kas gtso bos phyag dang po bzhi mtshon/

de ltar nges par byas nas ji ltar bsgom pa'i tshul ni/ chos 'byung gi zla ba'i dbus su baṃ yig gi ngo bo rnal 'byor ma dmar mo/ baṃ yig gi srog ya ra la wa bzhi las/ shar du ya'i ngo bo rnal 'byor dkar mo/ g.yon du ra'i ngo bo rnal 'byor ma ljang khu/ rgyab tu la'i ngo bo rnal 'byor ma dmar mo/ g.yas su wa'i ngo bo rnal 'byor ma ser mo/ mthar sngags phreng so gnyis kyang re re nas rnal 'byor ma dmar mo re re ste kun dril lus dkyil gyi lha so bdun rgyan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa phyi'i rnal 'byor ma dang 'dra ba thugs khar 'khor lo lnga brtsegs kyang gsal btab/ 'di'i zab gnad rdo rje'i lus la yul chen sum cu so bdun gyi rtsa khams yi ge rnams tshang bar gnas/ de'i nus pa snying dbus la gnas pa'i rtsa khams la tshang ba ste rgyas par gong du rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i lung / rtsa'i mchog gi grong khyer du/ /zhes sogs kyi lung don/ dang por a wa d+dhu ti nas rgya mtsho'i nang du skar ma shar ba bzhin zhes pa'i bar de dag go /des na rnal 'byor ma'i snying po oṃ gsum ma la yig 'bru sum cu so gnyis/ baṃ yig srog gi a thung 'byung bzhi'i yi ge dang bcas pa 'byung / de rnams 'dir lhar bskyed pa'i lus dkyil 'di ni/ rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras la snyan brgyud 'bigs tu bzhugs pa brgyud pa zam ma chad pa las byung ba kho na yin zhing rjes 'brang nga yin lo phal cher gyi rna bas ma thos pa'i chos yin no/ /de'i phyir snod ldan ma gtogs/ dam tshig dang mi ldan zhing byin rlabs sogs ma thob pa rnams kyi rna lam du ming tsam yang mi bsgrag go /'di legs par bsgom na nang gi gnas so bdun gyi rlung sems thams cad dbu mar thim nas sa lam bsgrod cing / phyi rol gyi yul so bdun na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang dpa' mo rnams dbang du 'du ba yin te/ rtsa rgyud las/ yul 'di bdag gi bu mo gang /

/dpa' bo gnyis med rnal 'byor ma/ /de kun 'dod pa'i gzugs can te/ /yid kyi shugs kyis 'jug pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar lus dkyil bsgom pa'i tshe/ ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa dang bzlas pa'i tshe/ rnal 'byor ma dbus ma'i thugs kha'i baṃ yig sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phro bsdu byed pa yin no/ /tshar chen gyi gsung rgyun las ni 'khor rnams kyi thugs kha'i 'khor lo lnga brtsegs kyi gsal kha mi snang ngo / /smras pa/ snying dbus bzhugs pa'i mkha' spyod ma gang de/ /snying nas grub par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i/ /snying gi gdams pa mchog 'dis tshim byas nas/ /snying ltar gces pas dam du sba bar gyis/ /zhes pa ltar rtogs par bya'o/ /brgyad pa dpa' bo dpa' mos byin gyis rlabs pa ni/ gzhung las/ slar yang yig 'bru'i tshogs kyi 'od zer gyis/ dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs thams cad spyan drangs te bdag nyid la bzhugs par bya'o/ /zhes gsung la/ sa skya pa chen pos/ yang 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma thams cad dang / sems can thams cad rnal 'byor mar bskyed pa thams cad kyang bdag gi ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas bsdus shing thim par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ gzhan las ye shes pa dgug gzhug 'byung ba'i don te/ de'ang lus kyi phyag rgya ni/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i bshad rgyud las/ mdzub mo 'dud bya zhes sogs gsungs te/ mthe bong gnyis lto sbyar/ mdzub mo gnyis 'dud/ gung mo gnyis rtse sbyar zhing / gzhan rnams 'bar ba ltar byas pas 'bar ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /sam+bu ṭa las/ ngo mtshar sgyu ma'i phyag rgya zhes gsung la/ rkang pa'i stabs sogs rgyun du ma grub kyang sngags phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gsum shin tu gal che bas/ sngags ni phaiṃ zhes pa mkha' 'gro'i dam tshig gi rdo rje brjod de/ phaiṃ zhes pa thung ngu ma yin par/ phaiṃ zhes/ phai dang e dang ma ste yi ge gsum gyi gdangs thon tsam byas te kho nya gsum gcig tu 'dus pa'i don yin la/

bod skad du khos zhes bya ba yin te/ sngags dang phyag rgya 'dis spyan drangs pas gal te mi 'byon na dam tshig nyams pas mgo khos zhes gsungs pa'i don yin gsungs pas phaiṃ gyi sgra dang bcas shing mig gyen du sgreng / rkang pa'i mthe bong g.yas pas g.yon pa mnan/ lus kyi 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral ba'i dbyings su lan gsum g.yon bskor du bskor/ sems kyi dmigs pa thugs kha'i baṃ yig las 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu'i rnam pa can 'phros dbu ma'i nang nas yar song nas smin mtshams kyi thad nas thon nas 'og min na bzhugs pa'i lhan skyes kyi rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas byang sems kyis bskor ba dang / yul nyer bzhi na bzhugs pa'i zhing skyes kyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams dang / 'gro ba rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gyur pa sngags las skyes pa rnams 'od zer gyi sna la/ steng nas char 'bab pa dang / 'og nas rlung rdol ba dang / bar nas dge 'dun chos 'khor la 'byon pa ltar bsam zhing dzaḥ zhes pas byon/ hūm̐ zhes pas nye bar byon/ baṃ zhes pas rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dam tshig par gsal ba'i spyi bo la sogs pa'i ba spu'i bu ga rnams nas bstim/ hoḥzhes pas ye shes pa'i ngo bor ro gcig tu gyur par bsgom/ mkhyen brtse bas dzaḥ zhes pas rang gi spyi bor byon/ hūm̐ zhes pas sib kyis thim/ baṃ zhes pas chu la chu bzhag pa bzhin du dbyer med du 'dres/ hoḥs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi dbang du gyur te dus gtan du nam yang mi 'bral bar bsam/ phyag rgya ma byas kyang btub/ spro na kyai rdor ltar bya gsung / mngon brjod las/ ye shes 'khor lo de ltar de/ /chos rnams kun gyi ngo bor bya/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor sbyor ba yis/ /chos kun ro gcig gyur par bsgom/ /zhes gsungs so/ /des na 'og min gyi lhan skyes longs sku dang / yul nyer bzhi sogs kyi zhing skyes dang sngags skyes gnyis sprul sku yin te/

de rnams kyang chos sku las 'byung bas sku gsum gyi bdag nyid nga'o snyam du nga rgyal bzung ste/ pad skor gyi mthar 'khyud 'khyud rgya bya ba ni thabs shes zung 'jug gi mtshon byed yin/ dril bu lus dkyil gyi ngag 'don gyi tho yig pa'i phyag rgya byas nas oṃ yo ga shud+dha sogs brjod de/ paṇa chen grags rgyal gyis gsung la mkhan chen legs 'byung gis zin bris mdzad par/ rnam lnga 'dod bskor dbus su gsum/ g.yas g.yon du re re'o/ /nub sogs steng 'og tu re re'o/ /dbus dang g.yas g.yon du re re ste lngar byed/ yo ga ni rnal 'byor yin la/ de'i don yang thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa/ rnal 'byor de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bdag nyid thabs shes gnyis su med pa la gnas pa de bzhin 'gro ba thams cad kyang thabs shes gnyis su med pa la gnas par bsam ste gsang mtha'i zab khyad pho nya gsum bsres te de dag thams cad rang sems gcig po nyid de dang der snang ba yin la de nyid 'di nyid du nyams su len pa nas skye bo dam pa kun 'dus pa/ zhes ba'i nyams len ste rig pa brjod med du cham me bzhag go /des na go cha bgos pa ni/ gzhung las dngos su ma bshad kyang bla ma'i man ngag gi kha bskangs te slob bshad ltar na shing gnyis gzer gyis bsdom pa dang 'dra bar yi dam dang 'bral med du 'ching ba'i don gyis ye shes pa bcug pa'i rjes su bkod de/ lte ba la sogs par rnal 'byor ma drug yi ge'i rnam par bkod de/ lha nyid sngags kyi gzugs kyis ni/ /bsgrub pa po la dngos grub ster/ /zhes gsungs pas/ de yang rang rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i lte ba la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du oṃ baṃ la sogs pa dpa' mo'i cho ga rnams ngo bo lha yin kyang rnam pa yi ge'i gzugs su bsgom pa ste/ lte ba'i nang thad du oṃ baṃ/ oṃ g.yas phyogs dang /

baṃ g.yon phyogs su'o/ /de'i gzhan rnams rigs 'gre/ snying khar baṃ yig gi mdun du haṃ yaṃ/ lce gzhung du hriṃ moṃ/ dpral ba'i skra mtshams kyi nang du hriṃ hriṃ/ spyi gtsug gis rus pa dang klad pa'i hrag du hūm̐ hūm̐/ yan lag thams cad la zhes pa gru mo dang spyi zur rnams sbangs pa'i tshigs chen brgyad ni rkang pa'i tshigs bzhi lag pa'i tshigs bzhi ste/ tshigs de rnams kyi bar du phaṭa phaṭa/ yig 'bru de rnams kyi kha dog ni sgrub thabs rnams su 'byung ba ltar yin cing lha de dang de'i ngo bo yin snyam du bsgom mo/ /dpe la lar spyi zur 'dug ste dpyod/ de ltar go cha bkod pa'i dgos pa gzhan yang bar chad bsrung ba dang / mngon shes drug 'char ba sogs rje btsun rtse mo'i bshad do/ /go cha bgos pa ni ye shes pa bzhugs pa'i snga rting gang la bsgom kyang 'gal ba med de sngon la bsgom pa rgyud rgya gzhung phal cher gyi dgongs pa yin zhing / rting la bsgom ba jo bo nā ro ta pa'i man ngag yin par gsung bas 'di ni de nyid kyi rjes su 'brangs pa yin no/ /'di la dbang bskur rigs bdag gi rgyas 'debs pa 'ga' zhig rgyas par byed kyang / 'di'i lugs kyi spros pa shin tu chung ba'i skabs yin pa'i phyir/ rigs bdag rang chas su bsgom pa ma gtogs dngos su mi byed do/ /'di nyid kyi tshe rang chas 'di ka gzhung dang mthun/ mdun bskyed lta bu spros pa la dga' ba'i tshe/ dbang bskur rgyas btab byas kyang rung gsung / dgu pa bzlas pa ni/ slob dpon gyi gzhung las/ sngags kyi phreng ba de nyid la zhugs pa dang / yid dang ngag gi dbye bas bzla bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs/ sa skya pa chen pos/ ngag bzlas byed na snying kha'i sngags 'phreng la dmigs la bzlas pa bya/ yid bzlas ni don la rdzogs rim mtshan bcas te/ de yang bde ba bskyed par 'dod na gsang gnas su chos 'byung nyis brtsegs sam rkyang pa gang rung dmar seng ba bsgom/

de'i grwa rnams su dga' ba 'khyil ba g.yung drung bzhi yang dmigs la baṃ yig la sngags 'phreng g.yon bskor du bkod/ de la dmigs te steng rlung mnan 'og rlung yang bskum te/ de lta bu'i yid kyi bzlas pa bdun nam lnga'am gsum bya'o/ /zhes gsungs la/ de la ngag bzlas yid bzlas gnyis kyi dang po ni bzlas pa'i yul phreng ba mang yang 'dir/ dung chen phreng ba blangs nas ni/ /zhes pa dung chen mi rus yin la/ de yang mi rus gang byung gi mi chog cing / thod phreng nges par dgos so/ /phreng ba byin rlabs ni kyai rdor ltar byas pas chog ste/ kyai rdor gyi phreng ba byin rlabs yang saṃ bu ṭir 'byung zhing / saṃ bu ṭi bde kye gnyis ka'i thun mong gi bshad rgyud yin pas so/ /des na phreng ba byin rlabs byed tshul ni/ rang lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pa'i sgo nas rang gi lag pa g.yon pa'i sor mo rnams pad+ma 'dab ma lnga dang lag pa'i mthil du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la a ā sogs nas aṃ aḥ'i bar brjod de dbyangs bcu drug gi g.yon du bskor ba'i lte ba la a lag pa g.yas pa'i sor mo lnga rdo rje rtse lnga pa lag pa'i mthil du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la/ ka kha nas k+ṣa'i bar du brjod de gsal byed kyis g.yas su bskor ba'i lte ba la hūm̐/ gung mdzub gnyis kyi bar du sum dkar po rnams bsam nas mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i phreng ba la nang mchod kyis gtor la/ sum+bha nis bsangs/ sa bhā was sbyangs pa'i phreng ba pad bskor sngon du 'gro bas blang la/ lag pa gnyis kyi bar du bcug ste/ sor mo'i rtse rdo rje dang pad+ma snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems sum la khyab/ de ā li kā li la khyab/ de phreng ba dang gnyis su med par gyur par bsam la/ oṃ pa de pa de ma hā dzñā naṃ sarba bud+dha ma yaṃ bha we te hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho ā khaṃ swāhā/ zhes pa thog mar byin rlabs kyi dus/ phreng skor gcig bzlas/

de rjes thun re la nyer gcig la sogs pa ji ltar rigs pa bzla ba ni phreng ba byin rlabs yin zhing / phreng thag dgu dril mdo 'dzin nyis brtsegs dgos tshul sogs rnam dbye rgyas pa man ngag rnam bshad sogs su blta'o/ /de nas ji ltar bzlas pa'i bsam gtan dngos ni lus dkyil bsgom na/ dbus kyi baṃ yig gi ngo bo rnal 'byor ma'i thugs kha dang / ma bsgom na rang gi snying khar chos 'byung nyis brtsegs zla ba'i dkyil 'khor baṃ yig yig 'bru rnams gsal btab/ de dag las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ rang gi lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas/ tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib rnams sbyangs/ 'od zer ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros/ de dag gi sna la phyi nang gsang gsum gyi mchod pa'i bye brag dpag tu med pa sprul te/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sogs myang 'das rnams la mchod pa'i sprin bsam gyis mi khyab pa phul bas thugs rgyud zag med kyi bde ba khyad par can brnyes pas/ rang gi tshogs rdzogs shing sgrib pa dag yang 'od zer de khams gsum snod bcud thams cad la phog pas snod thams cad chos 'byung dang / sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang la bkod pa ni rnal 'byor ma'i skur bsgyur ba'i don no/ /de dag ni ye shes kyi bzlas pa'o/ /yang 'od zer rnams rim gyis rang la bsdu ba'i tshe/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi yon tan byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad pho nya gsum gyi byin rlabs dang / mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub kyi ngo bo yin pa la rnam pa 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par nam mkha' gang ba byon nas rang gi snying kha'i baṃ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs shing /

mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa thob par gyur par bsam pa ni dam tshig gi bzlas pa'o/ /yang las gang byed dang mthun pa'i 'od zer spro bsdu yang rung gsung / de dag ni spro bsdu'i bzlas pa'o/ /bkod pa'i bzlas pa ni/ sngags kyis yig 'bru rnams mgo gyen bstan de dag klog pa'i tshul gyis bzla ba'o/ /rig byed 'don pa lta bu'i bzlas pa ni sngags rnams ring thung phyed cing skad mdangs dang bcas/ bzla ba'o/ /'di ni snod min gyi mi thos pa'i sa dang / gnyid rmugs kyi bying na bya'o/ /shub bu'i bzlas pa ni sngags kyi sgra rang gi gos kyi gong bas tshor tsam du bzla ba gtso 'di che'o/ /rang nyid kyi sngags 'dren pa bzhin du dgra gnyen bar ma'i sems can dang / lus kyi srin 'bu tshun chad thams cad rnal 'byor ma'i skur gsal bas/ sngags kyi sgra di ri di ri 'dren par bsam mo/ /sgo gsum 'jug pa rtse gcig tu dril nas bzlas na phan yon shin tu che ste/ dgos med rnam rtog la shes pa rgya yan du btang nas/ sngags bgrangs pa'i grangs ji tsam mang kyang byin rlabs mi 'byung bas na/ rang gi ma byung bar lha dang bla ma gdams ngag la 'khar ra byed pa mang du gda' ste chos spongs gi las su 'gyur bar gsungs la/ dmigs pa rtse gcig dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas bzlas brjod byas na byin rlabs kyi mtshan ma gdon mi za bar 'byung ngo / /bde mchog sdom 'byung las/ gdong drug gi rgyud la zer ram/ gzhan du mi 'gro'i sems kyis ni/ /de lta'i tshul gyis bzlas par bya/ /yul gzhan blo ni 'gro ba yis/ /bskal bar bzlas kyang 'bras mi 'byin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bzlas bya sngags kyi don/ phal cher gong du bshad zin la/ 'dir bod skad du bsgyur du rung ba rnams skad gnyis shan sbyar na/ oṃ gsum gyi don ni/ mchog ster ba dang sngags kyi mgo 'dren pa sogs don brgyad la 'jug par bshad de 'dir mchog ster ba gtso bor bzung ngo /

/sarba thams cad/ bud+dha sangs rgyas/ ḍā ki nī ye mkha' 'gro ma/ badz+ra rdo rje/ war+ṇa nī ye/ kha dog ma ste rgyas par na kha dog ma rdo rje'i rigs can ma zhes 'byung ngo / /badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad ma/ hūm̐ gsum ni sdug bsngal 'joms pa sogs du ma la 'jug phaṭa gsum ni khos sam shig ste bdud dang sdug bsngal 'joms pa'i don no/ /swāhā gzhi tshugs zhes pa'o/ /de la in+d+ra bhu tis yi 'bru rnams lha mo'i kha dog dang mthun pa dang / gnas spyi bo la sogs par bsgom par gsungs kyang / 'di ba'i lugs kyi gnas snying kha la sogs pa rnams su yig 'bru rnams kha dog dmar po bsgom la/ yi ge bskor lugs gong du bshad zin la/ don bsdu na sngags 'di'i steng du gzhi lam 'bras gsum thams cad mtshon pas skal bzang bdag gis bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i don can du go bar bya zhing sngags dag pa dang byin rlabs che ba'i phyir/ sngags btu ba'i cho ga ni/ rgyal chen in+d+ra bhū tis mdzad pa'i yi ge las shes par bya'o/ /mgo'i oṃ dang 'jug gi hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā rnams kyi sngags don gyi lung khung gsal po rdo rje rtse mo'i rgyud na bzhugs kyang 'dir yi ge mangs kyi dogs pas ma bris la lung nyer 'kho cung zad dang sbyar na/ sa skya pa chen pos/ yig 'bru rnams bri ba'i tshe re re dmigs la/ oṃ 'dra la sarba bud+dha zhes sogs bkod la klog pa'i go rim bzhin no/ /zhes dang / 'phags pas g.yon bskor du go rim bzhin bkod la bzla'o/ /zhes so/ /de ltar oṃ gsum ma thun re la yang brgya rtsa stong rtsa sogs dam bca' ji tsam yod pa las mi nyung ba mi tshig gis bar ma chod par bzlas shing / de'ang bsnyen pa lta bu ma yin pa'i dus rgyun du thun re la sum brgya 'am lnga brgya gang rigs mdzad gsung / kha cig oṃ gsum sogs yod pa'i rgyu mtshan rtsa sngags snying po nye snying phyogs gcig tu sdebs pa mtshon zer ba mi 'thad gsung ngo /

/tha na'ang brgya rtsa la sogs pa dam bca' las mi nyung ba bzla ba gal che ste/ spyir gsang sngags thams cad kyi zab pa'i mthar thug pa ni 'khor lo bde mchog gi skor 'di rnams yin par gsungs zhing / de'i yang zab mthar thug pa ni rje btsun lū nag dril gsum gyis mdzad pa'i lam rim rnams yin la de'i don gyi snying po ma lus pa 'dus pa'i man ngag gi yang rtser gyur pa ni nā ro mkha' spyod kyi lam 'di nyid yin par gsungs pa dang / gzhan yang sgrub bya'i yul du gyur pa'i mkha' 'gro ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod kyang / de rnams bye ba phyed dang bzhi ru bsdus pa yin la/ de yang stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis su bsdus shing / de yang sum cu rtsa bdun du bsdus/ de yang nyi shu rtsa bzhi'am brgyad dam lngar bsdus/ de yang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma 'di kho na la bsdus te/ mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyis/ mkha' 'gro grangs med bsam gyis mi khyab na'ang / /de nyid bye ba phyed dang bzhi'i yang bsdus/ /de snyed stong phrag bdud bcu rtsa gnyis su/ /brtson chen la sogs nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i bsdus/ /de nyid la ma la sogs drug tu 'dus/ /kun 'dus bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la 'dus/ /zhes mchod brjod gsungs pa ltar ro/ /des na 'di nyid gcig pu bsgoms shing bsgrubs pas mkha' 'gro ma bye ba rab 'byams ri rab kyi rdul dang mnyam pa sgom pa dang bsgrub par 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin du 'di'i gsang sngags oṃ gsum ma la yang / sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' 'o mkha' 'gro thams cad kyi ngo bo 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi sngags thams cad 'dus par bshad pas/ de la dgongs nas bla ma gong ma rnams kyis bde mchog lū nag gi byin rlabs drug skor gyi skabs dang / rnam rgyal bum pa'i lha thams cad kyi bzlas sngags la yum gyi nye snying kho na bzlas cho gar gsungs pa yin la/ des na gsang sngags oṃ gsum ma 'di la chig sgril du byas pas sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad kyi thugs 'khul zhing byin gyi rlobs par gyur cing /

oṃ gsum ma lan gcig brjod pas kyang bskal pa mang po'i sgrib pa 'dag par nges pa yin te/ de'i rgyu mtshan gsang sngags pa rnams tshe gcig lus gcig la dngos grub thob pa'i gnad kyang 'di 'dra'i rigs kyi zab gnad dang ldan pa las 'byung ba yin par gsungs pa sogs rtsod pa dang bral ba'i rje btsun gong ma rnams kyi gsung rab dang gsung rgyun dag las spyir mi lus lan gcig tsam thob pa'i dus 'dir gsang sngags zab mo'i lam nyams su len pa shin tu skal pa bzang pa'i tshul dang / lhag par mkha' spyod dbang mo 'di nyid kyis bzlas bsgom nyams su len pa la phan yon gzhan las ches che ba'i sgrub byed mang du 'byung ngo / /de yang lam 'di nyid la rten nas rgya bod du mkhas grub bya khyu 'phur ba lta bu mang du byung ste mdor bsdus tsam sngags 'chang thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis mdzad pa'i mkha' spyod ma'i dkyil chog gi 'jug tu blta'o/ /bsnyen pa bya tshul ni 'og tu 'chad do/ /gnyis pa yid bzlas ni lto 'brangs ltogs snyom pa'i dus su rlung ro rnams lan dgu phrugs su byas/ de tsam ma byung na'ang g.yon nas lan gsum 'bud pa'am/ g.yas g.yon gnyis ka gsum la dmigs te 'bud pa gang rung bya zhing / de nas 'og rlung snyan gsan 'bebs pa'i tshul du cung zad bskums/ steng rlung lus dgug byas nas dal bus rngubs rlung rdzogs rjes mchil ma'i rta dang bcas te lte bar ldig ste bskyur ba dang mnyam du chos 'byung nyis brtsegs zla ba baṃ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa bde ba bskyed par 'dod na gsang gnas su mi rtog pa skye bar 'dod na lte bar phab ste 'og rlung rdzogs par 'then la rlung bum pa can nam kha sbyar du grags pa bzung ste/ lus dkyil bsgom na mi dmigs pa'am yig 'brur bsgyur ba gang rung bya'o/ /chos 'byung gi mdun rgyab spangs pa'i grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil ba bde ba'i nyams dang ldan pa dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa g.yon skor du 'khor ba la sems gtad dga' ba 'khyil ba yig 'bru g.yon skor du klog pa'i tshul gyis lan bdun la sogs pa ci nus yid kyis bzla/

phyis goms dang grangs mang du bya'o/ /de dag kyang klog lugs oṃ la sogs pa'i 'bru rnams thad ru klog sarba sogs tshom bu rnams g.yon skor klog rlung mi thub na dal bus slod yid bzlas 'di rdzogs rim mtshan bcas yin pas drod dang bde ba skye zhing 'phar g.yo drag tu 'byung la de byung na rim gyis slod/ du ba la sogs pa'i rtags thams cad kyang 'di las 'byung gsung / bzlas pa'i mthar mdun gyi nam mkhar rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yid dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams bzhugs par dmigs la byung na thun re la sngags grangs ci tsam song ba nges par byas nas bla ma dang yi dam gyi mtshan nas bzung de rnams la dgongs gsol byas la bdag gi thun 'di la sngags 'di tsam song ba bla ma yi dam gyi sku gsung thugs la 'bul lags na thugs brtse can gyi bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlabs du gsol/ zhes grangs yi dam la gtad pa gdams pa'i mchog yin gsung / bzlas pa phul nas yig brgya dang rten 'brel snying po tshar gsum gsum bzlas na shin tu legs so/ /de tsam ma byung yang / bzlas pa bsdu ba na/ phreng ba thal mo'i bar du bzung la/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyis sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ myur du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod cing phreng ba mgo thog du bzhag go /bzlas pa'i sbyang gzhi la rigs drug gi skad sna tshogs rdzun phra ma la sogs pa ngag gi las sgrib thams cad dang / de dag gi bag chags sems la tshang / de lus dkyil 'khor bzhi dang / khyad par du rgya yig dang bod yig gis rnam par shar ba thams cad/ sbyong byed 'dir de thams cad sngags phreng du bsgom/ rlung thams cad skad gdangs su bsgom/

rnam rtog thams cad 'od zer du bsgom pas srid pa gsum gyi tha lam gyi sgra dbyangs thams cad spangs pa mkha' spyod ma'i gsung sgrub par byed pa'i gdams ngag ste/ chos rje rdo rje 'chang gis/ oṃ gsum ldan pa'i gsang sngags yi ge'i tshogs/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gi don/ yid bzlas kyi sbyang gzhi gzhan la mi mngon pa'i sgo nas bsam ngan brnab sems gnod sems log lta sogs yin par bshad do/ /de ltar bshad ma thag pa'i bskyed rim bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor dang bcas pa de dag dbang bzhi'i lam lus la dril nas nyams su len pa yin te/ ngag bzlas yid bzlas ni bskyed rim gyi lam/ lte bar yid bzlas byed pa gsang dbang gi lam/ gsang gnas su yid bzlas byed pa shes rab ye shes kyi lam/ de dag la rten nas bde chen gyi ye shes skyes pa ni bzhi pa'i lam mo/ /de dag re re la'ang dbang bzhi'i lam tshang ste/ rang nyid rnal 'byor ma rten dang brten par bcas par bsam par bum dbang gi lam/ chos 'byung zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yig 'bru dang bcas pa gsang dbang gi lam/ dga' ba 'khyil pa rnams shes rab ye shes kyi lam ste/ de'ang dga' ba la sogs pa'i dga' ba bzhi mtshon pas dga' 'khyil bzhi zur med pa ni rnam rtog gi grwa zur med pa'o/ /dga' ba bzhi po re re la'ang / bzhi bzhi mtshon pas dga' 'khyil re la g.yung drung ris bzhi bzhi ste bcu drug de dag la brten nas bskyed pa'i bde chen gyi ye shes ni gzhi'i lam mo/ /de'ang rdo rje 'chang gis/ dbang bzhi'i don ldan bskyed rim zab mo'i lam/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gi don no/ /'dir zhar byung gi rdzogs rim cung zad 'byung ba rje ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i khrid yig tu shes so/ /'on kyang 'di 'og nas 'byung ba'i chos rje dpal rdor ba'i gsung dang gnad 'dra bar 'dug go /rje mkhyen brtse ba dang ngag dbang chos grags gnyis kyi yig cha la'ang go rim cung zad mi 'dra ba 'dug pas dpyad do/

/bcu pa bsam mi khyab kyis rnal 'byor ni/ gzhung las/ de nas baṃ yig gi 'od zer gyis sa gsum lus dang lus yi ge rim gyi bsam gyis mi khyab pa la gzhug pa sngon du 'gro bas de kho na nyid bsgom par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs/ rje sa chen gyis/ snying kha'i sngags phreng las 'od 'phros pas/ khams thams cad 'od zer gyis khengs/ de yang gzugs med khams lus kyi stod kyi cha la/ gzugs khams bar gyi cha la/ 'dod khams smad kyi cha la/ rang yang chos 'byung la/ chos 'byung dang zla ba/ zla ba'ang sngags la/ de baṃ yig la/ de thig le la/ de nā da dkar dmar du gyur te chu la rlabs thim pa ltar/ de ci yang mi dmigs par gyur par bsam la/ de'i ngang la shes pa slod de/ de la ji tsam gnas tshad du bzhag go /zhi gnas shas che na lhar ldang / gsal ba bde ba shas che na stong par bzhag go /zhes gsungs te rgyas pa gong nyal ba'i rnal 'byor gyi skabs bshad pa ltar ro/ /bsam mi khyab kyi sbyang gzhi yang dus gsum gyi 'chi ba sbyong ba sogs nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ltar ro/ /skabs 'dir bsam mi khyab thun mong ma yin pa'i nyams len dang / 'da' kha ma'i gdams ngag du ma yod pa rnams mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags sogs kyi yig cha bzhin rang gi ji ltar thob pa nyams su blang bar bya zhing / rtsa dbu ma'i man ngag 'og nas 'byung ba ltar 'dir bsgom mo/ /de nas thun las ldang ba na go cha dran pa/ tsham rngam sngags kyis bsrung ba dga' ba gsum gsal 'debs pa bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis rnams bya/ gtor ma 'bul na cho ga sogs kyi gong du bya'o/ /de nas go cha sogs rjes chog spyi ltar bya'o/ /sku mdog dmar ba ni sems can la rjes su chags pa'o/ /zhes gong gi dag bya dag byed rnams dran par byas kyang rung ma byas kyang skyon med/ bcu gcig spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ni/ gzhung las dngos su mi 'byung yang shugs las bstan la sa skya pa chen pos/

rang dang snang ba thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur dmigs la lha la lhas mchod par bsam pa sku'i dga' ba/ de yang sgyu ma lta bu'i sku dang bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngang las ma g.yos par dran par bya ba thugs kyi dga' ba/ sgra ci grag pa thams cad ngag gi bzlas par bya ba gsung gi dga' ba ste de ltar don bcu gcig go /zhes gsungs so/ /mdor na spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor 'di la nan tan bya dgos te mnyam bzhag tu thugs dam mog mog re byas lo byas kyang rjes thob kun tu tha mal du lus na chos pa'i 'khyer so gtor 'gro gsung ngo / /de las 'phros pa'i don la zas kyi rnal 'byor phyi mchod/ sbyin sreg rgyas pa la'ang bzhi/ sdig pa sbyang ba'i phyir mar me'i sbyin sreg tshes bcu'i mchod pa gsum/ gtor ma'i rnal 'byor rnams dang / bzhi 'bum la sogs pa bsnyen pa ji ltar bya ba'i tshul/ sin+dhu ra'i sgrub pa bskyed rim gyi sems 'dzin/ man ngag gces btus sogs su 'byung ba'i rtsa dbu ma'i man ngag rnams mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags dang / rje kun dga' tshul khrims sogs kyis mdzad pa'i gong du rkang grangs smos pa'i yig char blta'o/ /'dir zas kyi rnal 'byor gyi gsal kha cung zad bri na/ rang gi mdun du kha zas 'dus byas nas gtor ma ltar byin gyis rlabs/ rang rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i thugs khar rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rgyan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa/ de'i mtha' bskor du bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis bskor ba dwangs gsal rnyog pa med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bur gyur/ zhes brjod cing dmigs la/ lte bar me 'bar ba'i khrod na dur khrod bdag po sogs chos srung nor lha'i tshogs dang bcas gsal bar gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam la/ lha de rnams mchod pa'i bsam pas kha hoṃ khung lag pa dgang gzar blugs gzar du bsam ste g.yas kyis g.yon du blugs cing zos pas phud kyi snying kha'i lha tshogs mchod lhag mas/

lte ba'i chos srung nor thams cad mchod par bsam mo/ /gal te lag pa g.yas pas g.yon du blugs cing za ba rgyun du ma byung na'ang bza' btung gang yin dang / so kham 'ga' de ltar bya/ de nas ci bde bya gsung / phud mchod dang chang bu sogs spyi dang 'dra'o/ /zas kyi rnal 'byor tshul cung zad mi 'dra ba rnams gzhan du rtogs par bya'o/ /'di ma chad pa gal che ste/ nang gi sbyin sreg tu 'gyur ba dang / rtsa ltung bcu gsum pa mi 'byung ba dang / kha zas bu lon can du mi 'gyur ba dang / 'dod sred kyis kun nas blangs pa'i gza' btung gi snang ba rnams sbyong nus so/ /bsnyen pa'i skabs su lag len phal cher gzhung 'di'i gong 'og gi shugs las kyang shes la/ de lta na'ang shar rgyal mkhar rtse ba bdag po ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan sogs kyi bsnyen thams yod do/ /der cung zad mi gsal ba mtshams lo gcig byed na sngon 'gro skyabs 'gro yig brgya maṇ+ḍal rnams zhag bdun bdun byed/ zla ba gsum byed na zhag gsum re'o/ /'di'i 'bru 'bum gyi don oṃ gsum ma la yig 'bru so gnyis/ baṃ yig gi srog yig bzhi dang bcas pa'i so bdun 'byung la/ de la bsnyen pa oṃ gsum ma 'bum phrag so gnyis sam so lnga so bdun rnams gang rung lo gcig la 'gro zhing sbyin sreg byed na des kha skong zhing / mi byed na khri phrag so bdun sogs kha skong du bzla'o/ /gzhung gi mjug don ni/ las dang po pa'i bsgom pa mdor bsdus pa/ slob dpon nā ro ta pa'i zhal gyi gdams ngag brgyud pa'i rjes su gnang ba rdzogs so// ༈ /rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ma ti'i zhal mnga' nas dang / dge slong pra dzñā kirtas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o/ /zhes so/ /'di la bskyed rim phag mo mkha' spyod ces gsungs kyang don gyi bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug yin pa'i phyir gzhan las khyad par 'phags te dbang bzhi lus sgrig gi nyams len gyi gnad kyis so zhes gsungs so/

/de dag gis ni rgya gzhung dang sbyar te bskyed rim phag mo mkha' spyod kyi rnam bshad mdor bsdus te bstan zin to// ༈ //gsum pa shin tu zab pa'i rdzogs pa'i rim pa bshad pa ni/ rdzogs rim gyi steng mkha' spyod 'khor lo la brten nas mi rtogs pa bsgrub pa/ 'og rlung gi 'khor lo la brten nas bde ba bsgrub pa/ bar gsang sngags kyi 'khor lo la brten nas drod bsgrub pa'i thabs rnams so// de yang rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom pa'i gang zag bskyed rim gyi sems 'dzin sogs legs par mthar phyin pa gegs sel sogs nges pa dang bcas pas bsgom dgos so/ /de la rdzogs rim rnam pa mang yang / 'dir rje mus chen bud+dha dh+wa dza'i rnam bshad ltar bshad na 'di ltar 'byung ste/ sa chen gyi chos 'byung rkyang pa bsgom na'ang / zhes pas rdzogs rim bstan pa yin te/ sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi gnyis las dang po ni/ tsham rngam sngags kyis bsrung 'khor bsgom/ de nas bla ma bsgom/ dpa' mo'i go cha bgod pa'o/ /'di ni sgrub thabs dang 'brel bar bsgom pa'i dbang du byas la/ gzhan du skyabs sems yig brgya bla ma'i rnal 'byor maṇ+ḍal dang bcas pa'i rjes su bsgom kyang rung bar bshad/ dngos gzhi la/ chos rje dpal rdor ba'i gsung gis rang rje btsun mar gsal ba'i gsang gnas nas smin mtshams kyi bar la dbu ma dmar po 'od zer gyi rang bzhin can gsal btab/ dbus ma'i mas sna ru rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi ngo bo chos 'byung dmar po gcig bsam/ de'i dbus su dpa' bo thams cad kyi ngo bo dga' ba 'khyil pa g.yon du 'khor ba la sems gtad/ dmigs pa gtso che rlung 'dzin pa med do/ /de ltar byas pas dbu ma kha phye der rlung sems thams cad 'dus/ dbu ma na yar zhugs pas bde ba'i ye shes skyes par bsam mo/ /yang smin mtshams su chos 'byung sngar dang 'dra ba la rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi ngo bo dga' ba 'khyil pa g.yon phyogs su 'khor ba sogs sngar dang 'dra bar byas pa las/

shes rab stong pa'i ye shes skyes par bsam mo/ /mthar gsang gnas dang / yang smin mtshams su chos 'byung dga' 'khyil dang bcas pa dbu mar zhugs snying khar kha sbyar bas bde stong dang dbyer med kyi ye shes skyes par bsam mo/ /yang rje zhwa lu pa'i gsung gi lte ba'i baṃ dang spyi bo'i haṃ dbu mas zung sbrel bar bsam la/ lte bar yid bzlas la sems gtad pas baṃ las me 'bar te dbu ma na yal tal song te haṃ la phog pas de las bdud rtsi rgyun babs pas 'bar 'dzag la sems gtad de/ de ltar byas pas bde stong gi ye shes dang / de la bogs dbyung ba'i phyir grwa bzhi'i dga' ba 'khyil pa rnams g.yon du 'khor bar bsam pas bde ba chen po g.yos te/ lus thams cad bde bas gang bar bsam mo/ /yang bsdus na chos 'byung phyi ma nang ma la bsdus nas chos 'byung gcig gi nang dpa' bo thams cad kyi ngo bo zla ba sran ma phyed bkas pa tsam gsal btab/ de'i steng du rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi ngo bo baṃ dmar yungs 'bru tsam gcig gsal btab/ de la rtse gcig tu yid gtad nas bsgom pas baṃ la me 'bar ba sogs sngar ltar bsgom pas bde stong gi ye shes skyes par bsam mo/ /de ltar thun mong ma yin pa'i rdzogs rim song nas da yab dang thun mong ba'i rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma nyams su len pa la rje btsun gyi yab la sbyar kyang / yum la sbyor bar bshad cing / mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las/ slar yang rdo rje phag mo yis/ /rnal 'byor ma yis rigs ldan mchod/ /de'i dus kyi ye shes ni/ /mkhas pas a wa dhu ti'i nang / /zhes dang / rnal 'byor ma mchog 'byung ba ni/ rtsa rnams kun gyis grong khyer mchog /stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyi/ /dbu ma a wa dhu ti'o/ /de ltar phag mo gtso bo ste/ /go 'phang mchog bzhin shes par bya/ /zhes so/ /'di nyams su len pa la gdams ngag gi mtshan nyid kyi rnam grangs/ zab pa'i dpe gsum/ dpe gsum dang ldan pa'i zab khyad gsum/

de dang ldan pa'i lam bsgoms pa las/ rtogs bya dngos po'i gnas lugs de la brten nas 'bras bu 'grub pa'i tshul/ sgrub byed kyis nyams su blangs pa rnams su yod pa las/ mtshan pa du ma yod de/ rtsa rgyud las/ pho nya lhan cig skyes grub ni/ /mchog dang 'bring dang tha ma ste/ /zhes pho nya mchod pa'i gdams ngag ces bya'o/ /da lan pho nya rtsa la byed pas/ mchog tu dbu ma 'bring nyer bzhi/ /tha ma bug pa brgyad kyi rtsa'o/ /'di ni pho nya mchog la mchod pa yin no/ /ci'i phyir pho nya bya na/ mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad 'gugs pa'o/ /de la rlung sems dbu mar chud dgos te/ de la bsdu dgos/ bsdud pa'i gdams ngag ni mu tig 'phreng ba'i mchan las/ rlung sems dbu mar bsdud pa'i gdams ngag gnyis te/ bdag lhar gnas pa dang / tsaṇ+ḍa li'o/ /zhes bshad pas le'u dang po'i brjod bya 'di yin par bstan no/ /yang rtsa rgyud las/ rnal 'byor ma dus khyad par du rigs ldan ma rnams rtag mchod bya/ zhes rigs ldan ma mchod pa'i gdams ngag ces bya'o/ /de la dmar chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi/ dbu ma la rigs ldan ma zhes bya ste/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyi rigs dang ldan pa zhes bya'o/ /zhes gsungs/ bla ma zhang bya ru bas/ rtsa sum cu rtsa drug la sogs pa'i rigs dang ldan pas so/ /zhes bshad/ kun spyod las/ bsam gyis mi khyab de bshad na/ /de ni bzung ni thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gdams ngag ces bya ste/ rlung sems dbu mar chud pa las rtogs bya dngos pa'i gnas lugs rtogs dgos/ de la brten nas stobs bcu la sogs pa'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa'i thabs yin no/ /rtags gnyis las/ kun 'dar ma ni dbus su gnas/ /gzungs dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs/ /zhes gzung 'dzin gnyis kyi rnam rtog btsan thabs su gcod pa'i gdams ngag ces bya ste/

dbu ma las gzhan pa'i rtsa gang du rlung sems gnas kyang gzung 'dzin skyed par byed la/ gdams ngag 'di'i sgo nas rtsa thams cad kyi rlung sems thams cad dbu mar bsdus nas gzung 'dzin dang bral ba'i gnyis med kyi ye shes rtogs pa'i thabs yin pas so/ /de ldan gyi gdam ngag de gzhan las zab pa'i rgyu mtshan ci zhe na zab pa'i dpe gsum dang ldan te/ shan pa srog gi gnad la mkhas pa/ 'khrul 'khor mkhan 'khrul 'khor la mkhas pa/ shing mkhan shing gi gnad la mkhas pa'o/ /dang po ni/ srog gcod pa la mkhas pa gcig gi rtsa gnas pa'i sa/ der shing bshags la sogs pa cung zad gcig bsnun pas sems can gyi srog 'gags/ rkang lag sogs la bsnun kyang de 'phral mi 'chi ba bzhin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ lho nub kyi phyogs la rgyal po bo dza de wa'i pho brang na zhal ba chu ris byas te de la rbal lcong la sogs pa'i gzugs brnyan bris/ sgo bzhir shing gi mi satwa gri thogs pa gnyis gnyis yod de/ gzhan gyis bltas pa'i tshe zhal ba chu mer ba la sbal lcong 'khrugs ba mthong ste/ der phyin pas shing gi mi'i dum bur btub pa gcig yod/ shing gi mi la 'dzings pas mi thub/ 'khrul 'khor gyi gnad la mkhas pa gcig gi 'khrul 'khor thag pa gcig yod pa de bcad na shing gi mi thams cad rang 'gyel du 'gro/ gsum pa ni lho phyogs ḍā ki pa ta zhes pa'i grong khyer na shing sdong po chen po gcig la mi satwa gri thogs pa brgya'i bcad kyang mi chod par che ru ka 'gro ba gcig yod/ shing gi gnad la mkhas pa gcig gi chu rgyu ba'i phrang bltas te/ de bug pa la shing gi gzer gcig rgyab na shing de rang skam la 'gro ba yin no/ /de bzhin du gzung 'dzin rnam rtog dbu ma 'bigs du bsdus nas nyams su blangs pas dbu ma'i kha phye/ kha phye nas der rlung sems 'dus nas gzung 'dzin thams cad rang 'gyel rang skam la 'gro ba yin no/ /rtog bya dngos po'i gnas lugs kyang der rtogs pa yin no/

/de bas na 'bad pas bsgom dgos te/ ma bsgom na mi rtogs ma rtogs na yon tan bdag rgyud la mi thob ste/ klu sgrub kyi bsgrub pa'i dngul chu bzhin no/ /de la dngul chu thig pa gcig la rdzas gser/ mu men/ mu tig khams dkar po/ rak+ta/ dri chen/ sha chen/ gla tsi/ mu zi/ dri chu ste bcu gcig bsres kyang che ru mi 'gro/ mdog kyang dngul chu mdog tu yong ba gcig yod la/ bcud len ma grub pa'i dus yon tan bcu gcig 'byung ba'i nus pa yod kyang sngon du mi 'gyur 'grub na sngon du 'gyur te/ gser gyi mdog ser ba dang lo drug brgya thub/ mu men gyis stobs che mig gi dbang po gsal/ byang sems kyis grang ba sel/ rak+ta'i rgyal po dbang du 'du/ dri chen gyis klu nad sel/ sha chen gyis mi ma yin pa dbang du 'du/ gla rtsi'i dri zhim/ mu tig gis mdog legs tshe ring / dri chus mtshon gyis mi tshugs par 'gyur/ de bzhin kun gzhi'i steng na yon tan rin po che'i 'byung ba'i nus pa yod kyang sngon du mi 'byung ba la gnas lugs rtogs dgos te/ rtogs pa la bsgom dgos pa yin no/ /dpe gsum gyis mtshon pa'i zab khyad gang zhe na/ gsum ste/ gzhi 'khor ba'i gnad/ rlung bsgom pa rnal 'byor ba'i gnad/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi gnad do/ /dang po ni 'khor ba'i zag bcas kyi lus dang rtog bcas kyi sems yin te/ rtog bcas kyi sems las rnam rtog de la nyon mongs pa/ de la las kyi dbang gi 'khor ba mtha' med du 'khyams pa yin te/ de gang gi nyes snyam na sems rlung dang 'phrad pas nyes te/ las kyi rlung dang ma phrad pa'i dus su sems gnyug ma ma bcos rnal du phebs pa yin la/ rlung dang phrad nas sems rnam rtog du song / rtsa tha dad du rgyus pas rnam rtog bcas/ rtsa tha dad du khams rgyus/ de rlung dang 'dres pas lus zag bcas su bya'o/ /de bzhin tu bshad na bag chags kyi sems pha ma'i khams dkar dmar dang ro gcig tu 'dres te/

bag chags thams cad khams dkar dmar la smin pas sems can gyi lus grub ste/ de yang thog mar lte ba'i gnas su rtsa a na hā ta bya ba mtshal gyi shad lta bu gcig chags/ de nas nam mkha'i rlung rgyu/ shar du dbyug tho lta bu/ de nas sa rlung rgyu/ lhor tsheg drag lta bu/ de nas me rlung / nub tu thong gu lta bu/ de nas chu rlung / byang du thig le lta bu/ de nas rlung gi rlung rgyu'o/ /de'i phyi skor la a ka tsa ḍa ta pa ya sha'i dbyibs can brgyad chags/ de nas 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung cha mnyam du rgyu'o/ /de'i phyi skor la rtsa 'dab bcu chags te/ rtsa ba'i rlung lnga dang yan lag gi rlung lnga ste bcu rgyu'o/ /de'i phyi bskor la rtsa 'dab bcu gnyis chags te/ pho gdangs kyis yi ge ring po drug dang / mo gdangs kyis yi ge thung ngu drug gi dbyibs su chags/ pho gdangs kyi rlung phyir rgyu ba dang gzung ba bskyed/ mo gdangs kyi rlung nang du 'jug pa dang 'dzin pa bskyed/ de'i phyir rtsa 'dab sum cu chags te sde tshan lnga dang / sbas pa sde tshan te/ ye shes sum cu'i dbyibs su yod/ sde tshan dang po nas sa rlung rgyu/ gnyis pa nas chu rlung rgyu/ gzhan la yang shes par bya'o/ /de nas 'khor lo rnams kyi rtsa brgya nyi shu rtsa mdud so gnyis/ yul nyer bzhi/ rtsa phran stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis la sogs pa chags so/ /de rnams su rlung btus pa las/ rlung bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phel te/ yul nyer bzhi la rlung dgu brgya ba phrag re yod pa las rlung nyi khri chig stong drug brgya la sogs pa las rlung bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod la/ de rnams kyi sems rtog bcas gzung 'dzin dang bcas pa stong rtsa de khams rus rlung dang 'dres pa las/ lus zag bcas skye 'chi dang bcas pa stong / khams dang rlung gcig yin kyang byed las tha dad de/ khams kyi rigs drug gi so dang sen mo la sogs pa'i lus bskyed rlung gi rtog bcas kyi sems bskyed de/

rim lnga las/ rnam par shes pa ni zhon pa'i/ /rlung zhes bya bas las kun byed/ /ces gsungs te/ de yang lte ba na gnas pa'i tshe/ gzung 'dzin rags pa ni mi bskyed/ sems rlong ba rnam rtog gi rtsa ba lta bu'i dus zhes/ snying khar gnas pa'i tshe sems dang 'dres/ gzung 'dzin bskyed pa lo ma'i rlangs pa lta bu'i dus zhes bya ba yin no/ /mgrin par slebs pa'i tshe dbang po'i sgo la brten nas/ yul la dmigs pa'i rtogs pa khar song ste/ 'bras bu smin pa lta bu'i dus zhes bya ste/ rim lnga las/ rlung rnams phra ba'i gzugs kyis ni/ /shes dang yang dag 'dres gyur pas/ /dbang po'i lam las byung nas ni/ /yul rnams la ni dmigs par byed/ /ces 'di rnams nad ngos bzung ba yin/ de sos par byed pa'i sman nyams su len pa la gsum/ sngon 'gro rlung sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi bdag nyid lhag par gnas pa/ mjug gtum mo tsaṇ+ḍa li kha 'byed pa'o/ /dang po la gsum te/ rab 'bring dang tha ma'o/ /de yang rlung che 'bring chung gsum la bzhag go /rab kyis zhag gsum la rlung mthar phyin te/ nyin zhag re la thun chen drug drug thun chen re la thun chung lnga lnga ste thun chen bco brgyad/ thun chung bcu drug la/ sa bcu gnyis kyi rlung stobs su 'gyur/ 'byung bzhi mnyam/ gtum mo'i drod skyes te mthar phyin pa yin no/ /'bring zhag bdun thun chung sngar dang 'dra/ tha ma zhag bco lnga la thun zhag phyed dang lnga brgya nas mthar phyin pa yin no/ /thun tshad nyin gyi sum cha yin la/ sum cha'i lnga cha thun chung gcig gi chod/ de yang nyi ma dang po'i snga thun la mtshon na/ de la thun chung lnga yod pas/ se gol gtogs pa dang pus mo la bskor ba gcig bya yang btang / yang gcig bya rlung btang / se gol gtogs pa dang pus mo la bskor ba gcig bya/ yang btang yang gcig bya rlung btang se gol gtogs pa pus mo la bskor ba gcig bya rlung btang / de ltar thun chung gcig po ma rdzogs par la ci nus bya'o/

/thun chen re la sngon 'gro rnams tshang bar bya'o/ /thun chung dang po rdzogs nas stan las mi ldang chang la sogs pa zas kyi bya ba cung zad byas la khams gso/ thun chung gnyis pa la pus mo la bskor ba gnyis bya rlung btang / yang gnyis bya rlung btang / de ltar ci nus bya'o/ /gsum pa la bab pa na se gol dang bskor ba gsum bya rlung btang / yang gsum bya rlung btang / de ltar gsum ma rdzogs bar la ci nus bya'o/ /rdzogs nas mi ldang zas sogs sngar ltar ro/ /bzhi pa la bab na se gol dang bskor ba bzhi bya/ rlung btang / yang bzhi bya rlung btang / de ltar ci nus bya'o/ /lnga pa la bab na lnga bya rlung btang / de ltar ci nus bya'o/ /'di gzhan la yang sbyar bar bya'o/ /de ltar byas pa'i zhag bco lnga'i thun chung tha ma la se gol dang bskor ba phyed dang lnga brgya'o/ /thun chung lnga rdzogs pa dang / thun chen gcig rdzogs pa yin pas/ langs la spyod lam bya'o/ /de ltar khog phub nas nyams su len pa la/ bca' ba lus kyi gnad rdo rje dkyil krung / lag pa mnyam bzhag lte bar gcer/ sgal tshigs drang po la/ mig snying kha mthong ba tsam bya/ gtad pa sems kyi dmigs pa ni/ rlung khams ji snyed yod pa thams cad lte bar sgril nas bsgom/ rje zhwa lu pa'i gsung gis/ dbyug tho lta bu la sogs pa rtsa rnams kyi nang du bsgom gsungs kyang / rje btsun gyi rtsa dang rlung thams cad phyogs gcig tu 'dril ba las/ thig ler gyur bar bltas la/ zhes gsungs pas/ rtsa nang du bsgom pa yin no gsung / dpe shar ljang / lho ser/ nub dkar/ byang dmar/ dbus su thig le sngon po sgom/ rnam pa thig le/ rgyu rlung lha yab yum lnga dang ye shes lnga yin no/ /de ltar dbus kyi thig le sngon po la sems gtad pas/ rlung phyir 'gro ba'i tshe thig le sngon po las sa rlung spos reng dud pa ltar lus kyi dkyil nas yar sngo na ra ra song / sna bug gi phyir ji ltar 'tshams pa gcig song bar bsam/

nang du 'jug pa'i tshe thig le sngon po la thim par bsam/ de ltar lan bdun tsam bya'o/ /mthar 'og rlung bskum thig le la bstim/ steng rlung mnan thig le la bstims te kha sbyar pus mo la bskor ba dang se gol gtogs pa gcig bya rlung btang / yang gcig bya rlung btang / de ltar ci nus bya'o/ /de ltar gzhan la yang sbyar bar bya'o/ /de ltar zhag bdun dang / gsum dang bco lnga las mthar phyin pa yin no/ /sngon 'gro rlung sbyang ba'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi rang nyid lhag par gnas pa'i rnal 'byor bsgoms pas/ dang po lte ba'i gnas su drod 'byung de nas lus la khyab pa 'byung / de nas gnas khang dang nye 'khor thams cad la drod 'byung / de'i stobs kyis tha mal gyi bud med dang sbyar ba'i bde ba'i dpe mtshon du med pa'i lus la bde ba 'byung ste/ rlung lus la chud pa'i rtags yin no/ /rang lus ras kyi 'dab ma ltar yang ba dang sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi sku'i ye shes rang yin snyam pa'i nyams 'byung ste/ rlung sems la chud pa'i rtags yin/ de nas snang mi snang bde mi bde la sogs pa las 'das pa'i nyams khyad par can 'byung ste/ dus de'i tshe rang gi lus kyang dbu mar 'jug pa snyam byed/ rtsa gnyis kyang dbu mar 'jug pa snyam byed pa 'byung ste/ dang po la tshor ba bde ba/ gnyis pa la mi rtog pa bde ba/ gsum pa la mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes bya ba yin te/ dus de'i tshe dbu ma kha 'byed du rung yang re zhig sngar gyi rgyun bskyang ste bsgom pas mnyam bzhag la dmigs pa gang bsgom kyang lag mthil gyi ri mo ltar du gsal/ rjes spyod du dang po du ba lta bu/ gnyis pa smig rgyu/ gsum pa srin bu me khyer/ bzhi pa mar me/ lnga pa 'od 'bar ba chen po/ drug pa zla ba/ bdun pa nyi ma/ brgyad pa rgyu skar gyi snang ba/ dgu pa rā hu la ste smad med pa'i zla ba nag po'am 'jigs su rung ba'i gzugs mthong /

bcu pa la ri mo nag po ste/ nam mkha' la thig btab pa lta bu'i rtags bcu mthong de tsam na dbu ma yang nor bu'i nang na skur pa yod pa ltar mi gsal ba'i tshul gyi spring spring dngos su mthong la lte ba'i aṃ la me sbar te smin 'tshams kyi bar du tal le 'bar ba mngon sum du 'byung ngo / /dbu ma kha rang 'byed la song nas der rlung sems 'dus na/ tshe 'di la phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob pa yin no/ /yang rtags thams cad ma mthong zhing ci rigs mthong na 'chi kha'am bar do la 'grub/ rtags ma mthong drod tsam skyes na mtho ris skye ba btud nas rten de las 'grub bo/ /de ltar nyams su len pa la dmigs pa gsum/ bdag byin gyi rlabs pa dang / tsaṇ+ḍa li la sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi gnyis la re re 'o/ /dang po nyams su len pa la/ bca' ba lus kyi gnad sngar las dam du btang ba tsam la/ gtad pa bsam gyi dmigs pa lte ba'i rtsa mdud kyi nang du phag mo ti la ka mtshal gyi shad lta bu'i steng du thig le dmar po gcig yod pa la gsal btab/ spyi bor haṃ gi steng du thig le dkar po yungs 'bru tsam yod pa mgo thur du bstan pa gsal btab/ de gnyis rtse dbu mar zung 'brel lo/ /rtsa g.yas g.yon gnyis kyang kha dog dmar po/ sbom phra gro sog 'bring po tsam/ lte ba nas spyi bo'i bar la gser gyi thur ma bshibs pa ltar yod/ spyi bo nas ro rkyang gnyis sba gug pa ltar gug pas sna bug gnyis la zug pa 'ong / dgang ba rlung gi gnad ni/ rkang mthil na rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i rlung yod pa de/ rgyu mo gzhung gnyis gul gul byas pas g.yos te/ brla'i rtsa bo che nas yar song sum mdo/ de nas 'og sgo 'byed 'dzum gyi sbyar ba byas pas/ gshang sgo'i rlung g.yos de dang sum mdo'i rlung gnyis kyi aṃ la bus pas aṃ las me cha phra ba 'bar/ ro rkyang gnyis nas yar song bas ltag par rtsom chen stobs kyi rlung zla ba phyed pa'i dbyibs su yod pa de bus pas spyi bor song /

de na yod pa'i haṃ dang rlung sna bug gnyis nas cung zad rngubs pa rnams kyi ro rkyang gi me klog ste/ aṃ gi gnas su cher 'bar/ des dbu ma kha phye te dbu ma na tal le 'bar ba la sems gtad de rlung kha sbyor/ 'di la thun grangs med do/ /de ltar bsgoms pas nyams snang la dbu ma la me stag phra bo 'phro ba snyam byed pa dang / me de la thig le dkar dmar 'phro snyam byed pa dang / rang gi lus la yang me stag 'phro ba snyam byed pa 'byung ngo / /de'i rgyun bskyangs te sgom pas/ dang po lte ba'i gnas su drod 'byung ba la sogs pa sngar bshad pa'i drod rtags rnams 'byung ste dmigs pa dang po'o/ /gsum pa gtum mo tsaṇ+ḍa li kha 'byed pa la/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi gnyis/ dang po/ tha mal gyi gtum mo dang 'od kyi gtum mo kha sbyar te/ lte ba nas 'bar ba tha mal dang / spyi bo nas 'bar ba 'od kyi'o/ /de la gtad pa sems kyi dmigs pa ni lte ba'i gnas su rtsa mdud gru gsum pa'i aṃ mtshal gyi shad lta bu/ de'i thig le yungs 'bru tsam dmar po/ de'i gseb tu k+ṣuṃ dmar tha mal gyi gtum mo zhes bya nag drod kyi rang bzhin can mgo thur bstan gsal btab/ de'i phyi skor la phyi mo brgyad g.yon bskor 'dab ma lnga bcu drug la g.yas skor du ka li so bzhi/ g.yon skor du a li bcu drug dang / thung ngu drug a i u e o aṃ/ drug po 'di ka li'i rjes la dang / de nas ā li ste thams cad g.yon bskor gyi lugs kyang snang / rnams bkod do/ /kha dog dmar po 'od zer rang bzhin can/ spyi bo haṃ las mgo thur bstan de'i spyi bor thig le dkar po/ de'i gseb tu k+ṣuṃ dmar nag 'od kyi gtum mo zhes bya mgo thur bstan no/ /aṃ dang haṃ gnyis rtsa dbu ma'i zung sbrel/ g.yas g.yon gyi rtsa gnyis kyang sngar ltar du gsal btab bo/ /dgang ba rlung gnad rkang pa gnyis phar drud tshur drud byas pas/

rkang mthil gyi rlung g.yos/ de bshang sgo'i rlung dang bsdongs te/ aṃ la bus pas aṃ las me 'bar te/ dbu ma nas song snying kha tsam du sleb/ yang sna bug gnyis nas rlung rngubs pas/ dpral ba dang ltag pa'i rlung g.yos/ haṃ la bus pas haṃ gi steng gi k+ṣuṃ las me 'bar/ dbu ma nas mar song snying khar slebs pa dang / me gnyis 'khrug chil 'dres te gcig gi gcig la thug brgyab pa dang / me stag phro phro 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad mer khengs te drod dpag tu med pa 'byung bar bsam mo/ /de ltar byas pas drod chen po skyes te drag na cung zad lhod la bzhag go /de ltar thun drug du bcad nas bhaiṃ/ 'di pa'i lugs kyi phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor mi dgos par rlung sems dbu mar tshud nas chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs spros bral gyi bde stong zung 'jug thabs lam la brten te slob pa'i sa bcu gnyis rim gyi bsgrod nas bcu gsum rdo rje theg pa'i sa mngon tu byed par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar byas pas dbu ma kha 'byed ran pa'i rtags gong du 'byung ba rnams bshad la kha 'byed pa'i gdams ngag gzhan sngar dang 'dra ba las 'bar 'dzag dkar dmar gyi rnam pa la sems gtad de/ rtsa rgyud las/ rnal 'byor pa dus khyad par du/ /rigs ldan ma rnams rtag mchod bya/ /zhes pas rigs ldan ma'i mchod pa yin no/ /rigs ldan ma'i mchog dbu ma yin pas de mchod par byed do/ /tshul ji ltar mchod na/ dus khyad par can zhes gsungs pas/ ku mud ta dang / pu li ra ma la ya dang / dza lan dha ra rnams byang sems thim pa dang longs spyod pa dang / dbang du bya ba dang gsum yod pa las/ spyir longs spyod pa ste/ byang sems kyi gang ba'i dus der mchod de/ yang so dang sen mo'i khams bskyed pa'i khams ji snyed thams cad spyi bor bsdus te/ dbu mar 'jug pa'i 'bar 'dzag la sems gtad de/ de dbu ma bde stong lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes skyes/

de'i rang nyid rje btsun mar gsal ba'i phung khams skye mched thams cad la rgyas btab nas bsgom pa ni/ rang rdzas thig les sangs rgyas dang / /byang chub sems dpa' mchod par bya/ /zhes pa'i don yin no/ /'bar 'dzag nyi shu rtsa bzhir yang 'gyur ba yin no/ /spyi don gsum pa lam nyams su blangs pa'i 'bras bu ni/ de ltar bskyed rdzogs gnyis la brten nas/ drod gsum rim par skyes shing gsang spyod dang / phyogs las rnam rgyal dang / nye rgyu'i nyams len rnams kyi lam mthar phyin pa rtsa thams cad e waṃ zug dang rnam rtog thams cad mi rtog pa'i ye shes lngar gyur pa'i 'bras bus mngon du byed pa'o/ /de yang mkha' spyod chen po ni sangs rgyas kyi sa ste sku gsum yan lag bdun ldan gyi go 'phang brnyes pa'o/ /'bring mkha' spyod dang rig pa 'dzin pa tshe 'di nyid la thob par byed pa ste/ mkha' spyod chung ngu ni 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku lo bcu drug lon pa'i ngang tshul can spyir longs spyod thams cad nam mkha' las 'byung zhing / rdzu 'phrul gyi nam mkha' la 'gro nus pa sprul sku las dngos su chos gsan cing sprul sku'i zhing khams su thogs med 'gro nus pa tshe de la sangs rgyas pa gcig yin gsung ngo / /de dag gi ni rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod kyi bskyed rdzogs kyi rnam bshad mkha' spyod lam bzang zhes pa rgyas bsdus mtshams pa'i ngag gi bstan zin to// ༈ //'dir smras pa/ zab rgyas chos tshul yid bzhin nor bu 'di/ /bshad dang sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser bkod nas/ /phan bde'i 'od brgya phyogs bcur 'byin mdzad pa'i/ /dam pa rnams kyis slar yang 'gro 'di bsrungs/ /dam pa'i don gyi de nyid ma mthong zhing / /mkhas pa'i rnam dpyod blo gros mi ldan yang / /mtshungs med sde snod 'dzin pa'i bkas bskul te/ /rang dang bskal mnyam don du tshul 'di bkod/ /'di la bdag blo dman pa'i skyon chags pa/
